Mats Wieffer.noteZh: 观察Mats Wieffer时，可以先看先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个比赛细节是他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。

Memphis Depay.name: Memphis Depay
Memphis Depay.summary: Memphis Depay (Dutch pronunciation: [ˈmɛɱfɪz dəˈpɑi]; born 13 February 1994), commonly known simply as Memphis, is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a forward for Corinthians in the Campeonato Brasileiro Série A and the Netherlands national team.
Memphis Depay.note: What separates Depay is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Depay draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Away from that action, he starts outside his marker and attacks the dropping ball.
Memphis Depay.noteZh: 观察Memphis Depay时，可以先看比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。另一个比赛细节是他会从盯防者外侧启动，主动攻击落点。

Micky van de Ven.name: Micky van de Ven
Micky van de Ven.summary: Micky van de Ven (Dutch: [ˈmɪki vɑn də ˈvɛn]; born 19 April 2001) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays either as a centre-back or left-back for Premier League club Tottenham Hotspur and the Netherlands national team.
Micky van de Ven.note: The key to van de Ven is recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. The next thing to watch is whether he gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Micky van de Ven.noteZh: 最能体现Micky van de Ven特点的是防线暴露后的回追速度。这一点直接体现在他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。接着可以问，他是否会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Nathan Ake.name: Nathan Ake
Nathan Ake.summary: Nathan Benjamin Aké (Dutch: ['naːtɑn 'aːkeː]; born 18 February 1995) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for Premier League club Manchester City and the Netherlands national team.
Nathan Ake.note: What separates Aké is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Aké holds the route into the box until support arrives. In another phase of play, he checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives.
Nathan Ake.noteZh: Nathan Aké的优势在于先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。最直接的表现是他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个值得观察的细节是他会在最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。

Noa Lang.name: Noa Lang
Noa Lang.summary: Noa Noëll Lang (born 17 June 1999) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a left winger or left midfielder for Süper Lig club Galatasaray, on loan from Serie A club Napoli, and the Netherlands national team.
Noa Lang.note: Watch Lang for changing direction without losing control of the ball. The clearest example is how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. Elsewhere, Lang draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Noa Lang.noteZh: 理解Noa Lang，要先看变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Quinten Timber.name: Quinten Timber
Quinten Timber.summary: Quinten Ryan Crispito Timber (Dutch: [ˈkʋɪntə(n) ˈtɪmbər]; born 17 June 2001) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as midfielder for Ligue 1 club Marseille and the Netherlands national team.
Quinten Timber.note: Timber's signature is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. Watch how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Away from that moment, he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Quinten Timber.noteZh: 理解Quinten Timber，要先看带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Robin Roefs.name: Robin Roefs
Robin Roefs.summary: Robin Gerardus Petrus Roefs (born 17 January 2003) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Sunderland and the Netherlands national team.
Robin Roefs.note: For Roefs, the foundation is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. Look first at how he sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. Also watch how he leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Robin Roefs.noteZh: Robin Roefs的优势在于提前站位后的快速反应。最直接的表现是他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。另一个值得观察的细节是他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Ryan Gravenberch.name: Ryan Gravenberch
Ryan Gravenberch.summary: Ryan Jiro Gravenberch (Dutch pronunciation: [Ryɑn ɣrɑvɛnbɛrx]; born 16 May 2002) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Liverpool and the Netherlands national team.
Ryan Gravenberch.note: Gravenberch stands out for carrying momentum through open midfield. He pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. Another aspect is how Gravenberch waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Ryan Gravenberch.noteZh: 最能体现Ryan Gravenberch特点的是带球穿过开放中场的推进力。这一点直接体现在他会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。除此之外，他也会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Teun Koopmeiners.name: Teun Koopmeiners
Teun Koopmeiners.summary: Teun Koopmeiners (Dutch pronunciation: [tøːŋ ˈkoːpmɛinərs]; born 28 February 1998) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Juventus and the Netherlands national team.
Teun Koopmeiners.note: The key to Koopmeiners is using his left foot as a passing outlet. He plays the available pass with his left foot. In another phase, Koopmeiners serves corners and free kicks into the attacking area.
Teun Koopmeiners.noteZh: 最能体现Teun Koopmeiners特点的是把左脚作为传球出口。这一点直接体现在他会用左脚送出眼前可行的传球。除此之外，他也会把角球和任意球送入进攻区域。

Tijjani Reijnders.name: Tijjani Reijnders
Tijjani Reijnders.summary: Tijjani Martinus Jan Reijnders (Dutch pronunciation: [tiˈdʒaːni ˈrɛi̯ndərs]; born 29 July 1998) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Manchester City and the Netherlands national team.
Tijjani Reijnders.note: For Reijnders, the foundation is carrying momentum through open midfield. Look first at how he pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. Separately, look at how he shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Tijjani Reijnders.noteZh: Tijjani Reijnders的比赛建立在带球穿过开放中场的推进力之上。首先看他如何把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。另一个方面是他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Wout Weghorst.name: Wout Weghorst
Wout Weghorst.summary: Wout François Maria Weghorst (born 7 August 1992) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a striker for Eredivisie club Ajax and the Netherlands national team. Weghorst began his professional career in the second tier of Dutch football with Emmen.
Wout Weghorst.note: Watch Weghorst for reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. The clearest example is how he starts outside his marker and attacks the dropping ball. Also watch how Weghorst pins a defender and creates room for the next runner.
Wout Weghorst.noteZh: Wout Weghorst的比赛建立在争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹之上。首先看他如何从盯防者外侧启动，主动攻击落点。另一个方面是他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。

Abdulkerim Bardakci.name: Abdulkerim Bardakci
Abdulkerim Bardakci.summary: Abdülkerim Bardakcı (born 7 September 1994) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Süper Lig club Galatasaray and the Turkey national team.
Abdulkerim Bardakci.note: What separates Bardakcı is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Bardakcı holds the route into the box until support arrives. Also note how he steps toward the flight and heads clear before the forward can set himself.
Abdulkerim Bardakci.noteZh: 先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢是理解Abdülkerim Bardakcı踢法的关键。先看他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。到了另一个比赛环节，他会迎向来球，在前锋站稳前头球解围。

Altay Bayindir.name: Altay Bayindir
Altay Bayindir.summary: Altay Bayındır (born 14 April 1998) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Manchester United and the Turkey national team. Bayındır began his career at Ankaragücü.
Altay Bayindir.note: Bayındır's signature is staying balanced until the shot reveals its direction. Watch how he keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements. At another point in the move, he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Altay Bayindir.noteZh: 观察Altay Bayındır时，可以先看射门方向明确前保持身体平衡。他会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。另一个比赛细节是他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Baris Alper Yilmaz.name: Baris Alper Yilmaz
Baris Alper Yilmaz.summary: Barış Alper Yılmaz (born 23 May 2000) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as a winger for Süper Lig club Galatasaray and the Turkey national team.
Baris Alper Yilmaz.note: The key to Yılmaz is using strength without slowing the next action. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. In another phase, Yılmaz moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Baris Alper Yilmaz.noteZh: Barış Alper Yılmaz的比赛建立在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步之上。首先看他如何承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。另一个方面是他会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Caglar Soyuncu.name: Caglar Soyuncu
Caglar Soyuncu.summary: Çağlar Söyüncü (Turkish pronunciation: [tʃaːˈɫaɾ sœjynˈdʒy]; born 23 May 1996) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Süper Lig club Fenerbahçe and the Turkey national team.
Caglar Soyuncu.note: For Söyüncü, the foundation is recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. Look first at how he turns early and protects the route toward goal. A separate point is how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Caglar Soyuncu.noteZh: 最能体现Çağlar Söyüncü特点的是第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。这一点直接体现在他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。除此之外，他也会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Can Uzun.name: Can Uzun
Can Uzun.summary: Can Uzun is a Türkiye attacking midfielder from Eintracht Frankfurt who gives the national team between-lines receiving, sharp shooting, and young creative upside.
Can Uzun.note: The key to Uzun is receiving in tight spaces with his next action already planned. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward. One more thing to notice is how Uzun shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Can Uzun.noteZh: 观察Can Uzun时，可以先看狭小空间接球前就想好下一步。他会在第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。另一个比赛细节是他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Deniz Gul.name: Deniz Gul
Deniz Gul.summary: Deniz Daniel Gül (born 2 July 2004) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Primeira Liga club Porto. Born in Sweden, he plays for the Turkish national team.
Deniz Gul.note: Watch Gül for waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. The clearest example is how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. A separate clue is how Gül angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Deniz Gul.noteZh: 最能体现Deniz Gül特点的是等防守者注意力转移后再启动。这一点直接体现在他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。除此之外，他也会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Eren Elmali.name: Eren Elmali
Eren Elmali.summary: Evren Eren Elmalı (born 7 July 2000) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Süper Lig club Galatasaray and the Turkey national team.
Eren Elmali.note: Elmalı's signature is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Watch how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Another detail is how he turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Eren Elmali.noteZh: 观察Eren Elmalı时，可以先看从后场加入进攻的启动时机。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个比赛细节是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Ferdi Kadioglu.name: Ferdi Kadioglu
Ferdi Kadioglu.summary: Ferdi Erenay Kadıoğlu (Turkish pronunciation: [fæɾˈdi eɾeˈnaj kaˈdɯoːɫu]; born 7 October 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a full back, midfielder or winger for Premier League club Brighton & Hove Albion.
Ferdi Kadioglu.note: What separates Kadıoğlu is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Kadıoğlu draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. A separate detail appears when he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Ferdi Kadioglu.noteZh: 变向时仍把球控制在脚下是理解Ferdi Kadıoğlu踢法的关键。先看他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Ismail Yuksek.name: Ismail Yuksek
Ismail Yuksek.summary: İsmail Yüksek (born 26 January 1999) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Süper Lig side Fenerbahçe and the Turkey national team.
Ismail Yuksek.note: Yüksek stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. A different detail is how Yüksek angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Ismail Yuksek.noteZh: 选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢是理解İsmail Yüksek踢法的关键。先看他如何等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Kaan Ayhan.name: Kaan Ayhan
Kaan Ayhan.summary: Kaan Ayhan (born 10 November 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for Süper Lig club Galatasaray. Born in Germany, he plays for the Turkey national team.
Kaan Ayhan.note: The key to Ayhan is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple. A separate part of his game is how Ayhan holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Kaan Ayhan.noteZh: 多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构是理解Kaan Ayhan踢法的关键。先看他如何改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。到了另一个比赛环节，他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Kerem Akturkoglu.name: Kerem Akturkoglu
Kerem Akturkoglu.summary: Muhammed Kerem Aktürkoğlu (Turkish pronunciation: [ceˈɾɛm akˈtyɾkoːɫu]; born 21 October 1998) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as a winger or wide midfielder for Süper Lig club Fenerbahçe and the Turkey national team.
Kerem Akturkoglu.note: For Aktürkoğlu, the foundation is explosive speed once open grass appears. Look first at how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Beyond the first action, he shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Kerem Akturkoglu.noteZh: Kerem Aktürkoğlu的优势在于看到空当后的爆发速度。最直接的表现是他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。另一个值得观察的细节是他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Merih Demiral.name: Merih Demiral
Merih Demiral.summary: Merih Demiral (born 5 March 1998) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Saudi Pro League club Al-Ahli and the Turkey national team.
Merih Demiral.note: Demiral's signature is reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. Watch how he meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. Away from that moment, he holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Merih Demiral.noteZh: Merih Demiral的优势在于争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。最直接的表现是他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。另一个值得观察的细节是他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Mert Gunok.name: Mert Gunok
Mert Gunok.summary: Fehmi Mert Günok (Turkish pronunciation: [mæɾt ˈɡynok]; born 1 March 1989) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Süper Lig club Fenerbahçe and the Turkey national team.
Mert Gunok.note: Watch Günok for staying ready through long quiet spells. The clearest example is how he keeps his decisions calm when a sudden save is required. Also watch how Günok keeps his hands and feet connected so the reflex block stays controlled.
Mert Gunok.noteZh: 理解Mert Günok，要先看长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。他会在突然需要扑救时仍能冷静判断。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会让手脚保持联动，使本能挡球也能控制方向。

Mert Muldur.name: Mert Muldur
Mert Muldur.summary: Mert Müldür is a Türkiye right-back from Fenerbahçe who gives the national team full-back defending, recovery speed, and back-post coverage.
Mert Muldur.note: What separates Müldür is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Müldür holds the route into the box until support arrives. Away from that action, he checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives.
Mert Muldur.noteZh: 先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢构成Mert Müldür踢法的核心。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。除此之外，值得留意他会在最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。

Oguz Aydin.name: Oguz Aydin
Oguz Aydin.summary: Oğuz Aydın is a Türkiye right winger from Fenerbahçe who gives the national team one-on-one dribbling, acceleration, and direct crossing.
Oguz Aydin.note: Aydın stands out for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Aydın also looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Oguz Aydin.noteZh: 变向时仍把球控制在脚下是理解Oğuz Aydın踢法的关键。先看他如何等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Orkun Kokcu.name: Orkun Kokcu
Orkun Kokcu.summary: Orkun Kökçü is a Türkiye central midfielder from Beşiktaş who gives the national team progressive passing, midfield shooting, and press-resistant control.
Orkun Kokcu.note: What separates Kökçü is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Kökçü takes the first available forward lane before it closes. At another point, he shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Orkun Kokcu.noteZh: Orkun Kökçü最鲜明的特点是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。一个直接线索是他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。另一个独立细节是他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Ozan Kabak.name: Ozan Kabak
Ozan Kabak.summary: Ozan Kabak is a Türkiye centre-back from TSG Hoffenheim who gives the national team aggressive duels, aerial defending, and recovery cover.
Ozan Kabak.note: The key to Kabak is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. A separate part of his game is how Kabak turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Ozan Kabak.noteZh: 理解Ozan Kabak，要先看选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Salih Ozcan.name: Salih Ozcan
Salih Ozcan.summary: Salih Özcan is a Türkiye defensive midfielder from Borussia Dortmund who gives the national team screening, duels, and disciplined possession support.
Salih Ozcan.note: Özcan stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Özcan also holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Salih Ozcan.noteZh: 观察Salih Özcan时，可以先看选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个比赛细节是他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Samet Akaydin.name: Samet Akaydin
Samet Akaydin.summary: Samet Akaydin (born 13 March 1994) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Süper Lig club Çaykur Rizespor and the Turkey national team.
Samet Akaydin.note: For Akaydin, the foundation is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Look first at how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. Beyond the first action, he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Samet Akaydin.noteZh: Samet Akaydin的比赛建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢之上。首先看他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个方面是他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Ugurcan Cakir.name: Ugurcan Cakir
Ugurcan Cakir.summary: Uğurcan Çakır is a Türkiye goalkeeper from Galatasaray who gives the national team shot stopping, penalty-area command, and long distribution.
Ugurcan Cakir.note: Watch Çakır for command of the crowded space around goal. The clearest example is how he leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders. Also notice how Çakır chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Ugurcan Cakir.noteZh: 掌控门前拥挤空间的能力是理解Uğurcan Çakır踢法的关键。先看他如何判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Yunus Akgun.name: Yunus Akgun
Yunus Akgun.summary: Yunus Akgün (born 7 July 2000) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or right winger for Süper Lig club Galatasaray and the Turkey national team.
Yunus Akgun.note: Akgün's signature is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Watch how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Away from that moment, he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Yunus Akgun.noteZh: 观察Yunus Akgün时，可以先看比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。另一个比赛细节是他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Zeki Celik.name: Zeki Celik
Zeki Celik.summary: Mehmet Zeki Çelik (Turkish pronunciation: [ˈzeci ˈtʃelik]; born 17 February 1997) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays for Serie A club Roma and the Turkey national team. Mainly a right-back, he can also be deployed as a centre-back in a back three.
Zeki Celik.note: Çelik's signature is closing the crossing angle without losing the runner. Watch how he gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in. At another point in the move, he protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Zeki Celik.noteZh: 封住传中角度时仍不丢掉跑动者是理解Zeki Çelik踢法的关键。先看他如何靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。到了另一个比赛环节，他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Irfan Can Kahveci.name: Irfan Can Kahveci
Irfan Can Kahveci.summary: İrfan Can Kahveci is a Türkiye right winger from Kasımpaşa who gives the national team left-footed crossing, combination play, and set-piece quality.
Irfan Can Kahveci.note: For Kahveci, the foundation is delivering the ball without needing much space. Look first at how he looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. Also watch how he protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Irfan Can Kahveci.noteZh: 很小空间里也能送出传中的能力是理解İrfan Can Kahveci踢法的关键。先看他如何在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。到了另一个比赛环节，他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Alex Zendejas.name: Alex Zendejas
Alex Zendejas.summary: Álex Zendejas is a United States right winger from América who gives the national team left-footed service, box arrivals, and Liga MX sharpness.
Alex Zendejas.note: Watch Zendejas for waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. The clearest example is how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. In a different phase, Zendejas looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Alex Zendejas.noteZh: Álex Zendejas最鲜明的特点是等防守者注意力转移后再启动。一个直接线索是他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。另一个独立细节是他会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Antonee Robinson.name: Antonee Robinson
Antonee Robinson.summary: Antonee Robinson (born August 8, 1997) is a professional soccer player who plays as a left-back for Premier League club Fulham. Born in England, he represents the United States national team.
Antonee Robinson.note: The key to Robinson is recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. One more thing to notice is how Robinson waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Antonee Robinson.noteZh: 观察Antonee Robinson时，可以先看防线暴露后的回追速度。他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。另一个比赛细节是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Auston Trusty.name: Auston Trusty
Auston Trusty.summary: Auston Levi-Jesaiah Trusty (born August 12, 1998) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a center-back for Scottish Premiership club Celtic and the United States national team.
Auston Trusty.note: What separates Trusty is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Trusty holds the route into the box until support arrives. In another phase of play, he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Auston Trusty.noteZh: 先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢是理解Auston Trusty踢法的关键。先看他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。到了另一个比赛环节，他会迎向落下的球，在对手站稳前参与争抢。

Brenden Aaronson.name: Brenden Aaronson
Brenden Aaronson.summary: Brenden Russell Aaronson (born October 22, 2000) is an American professional soccer player who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for Premier League club Leeds United and the United States national team.
Brenden Aaronson.note: For Aaronson, the foundation is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. Look first at how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Beyond the first action, he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Brenden Aaronson.noteZh: 观察Brenden Aaronson时，可以先看带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。另一个比赛细节是他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Chris Brady.name: Chris Brady
Chris Brady.summary: Christopher Keith Brady (born March 3, 2004) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club Chicago Fire and the United States national team.
Chris Brady.note: Brady's signature is keeping his body shape compact for reflex saves at close range. Watch how he keeps his hands and feet connected so the reflex block stays controlled. Another detail is how he leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Chris Brady.noteZh: 理解Chris Brady，要先看近距离反应扑救时保持紧凑身体姿态。他会让手脚保持联动，使本能挡球也能控制方向。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Chris Richards.name: Chris Richards
Chris Richards.summary: Christopher Jeffrey Richards (born March 28, 2000) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a center-back for Premier League club Crystal Palace and the United States national team.
Chris Richards.note: Richards stands out for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. In a separate phase, Richards holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Chris Richards.noteZh: 最能体现Chris Richards特点的是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。这一点直接体现在他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。除此之外，他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Cristian Roldan.name: Cristian Roldan
Cristian Roldan.summary: Cristian Roldan (born June 3, 1995) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club Seattle Sounders FC, which he captains, and the United States national team.
Cristian Roldan.note: Watch Roldan for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. The clearest example is how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Also notice how Roldan protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Cristian Roldan.noteZh: 看Cristian Roldan的作用，关键是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Haji Wright.name: Haji Wright
Haji Wright.summary: Haji Amir Wright (born March 27, 1998) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a forward or winger for Premier League club Coventry City and the United States national team.
Haji Wright.note: Wright stands out for using strength without slowing the next action. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. Also look at how Wright changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Haji Wright.noteZh: 对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步是理解Haji Wright踢法的关键。先看他如何承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。到了另一个比赛环节，他会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。

Joe Scally.name: Joe Scally
Joe Scally.summary: Joseph Michael Scally (born December 31, 2002) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a full-back for Bundesliga club Borussia Mönchengladbach and the United States national team.
Joe Scally.note: For Scally, the foundation is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Look first at how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. Beyond the first action, he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Joe Scally.noteZh: 先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢构成Joe Scally踢法的核心。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。除此之外，值得留意他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Malik Tillman.name: Malik Tillman
Malik Tillman.summary: Malik Leon Tillman (born May 28, 2002) is a German-American professional soccer player who plays as an attacking midfielder for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen. Born in Germany, he represents the United States national team.
Malik Tillman.note: Tillman's signature is reading the next phase before the space fully opens. Watch how he adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple. Another detail is how he moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Malik Tillman.noteZh: 理解Malik Tillman，要先看空当完全出现前读懂下一阶段。他会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Matt Freese.name: Matt Freese
Matt Freese.summary: Matthew Andrew Geary Freese (born September 2, 1998) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club New York City FC and the United States national team.
Matt Freese.note: The key to Freese is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. There is another side to his game: he leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Matt Freese.noteZh: 提前站位后的快速反应构成Matt Freese踢法的核心。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。除此之外，值得留意他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Matt Turner.name: Matt Turner
Matt Turner.summary: Matthew Charles Turner (born June 24, 1994) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Major League Soccer club New England Revolution, on loan from Ligue 1 club Lyon, and the United States national team.
Matt Turner.club: New England Revolution (on loan from Lyon)
Matt Turner.note: What separates Turner is the patience to read a penalty taker's last movement. Turner waits for the strike before committing. Away from that action, he sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Matt Turner.noteZh: 耐心判断点球手最后一下动作构成Matt Turner踢法的核心。他会等到对方触球前再做扑救选择。除此之外，值得留意他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Max Arfsten.name: Max Arfsten
Max Arfsten.summary: Maximilian Michael Arfsten (born April 19, 2001) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a winger for Major League Soccer club Columbus Crew and the United States national team.
Max Arfsten.note: What separates Arfsten is delivering the ball without needing much space. Arfsten looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. At another point, he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Max Arfsten.noteZh: 很小空间里也能送出传中的能力构成Max Arfsten踢法的核心。他会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。除此之外，值得留意他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Miles Robinson.name: Miles Robinson
Miles Robinson.summary: Miles Gordon Robinson (born March 14, 1997) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a center-back for Major League Soccer club FC Cincinnati and the United States national team.
Miles Robinson.note: Robinson's signature is recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. Watch how he turns early and closes the runner before the box. Away from that moment, he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Miles Robinson.noteZh: 最能体现Miles Robinson特点的是防线暴露后的回追速度。这一点直接体现在他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。除此之外，他也会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Ricardo Pepi.name: Ricardo Pepi
Ricardo Pepi.summary: Ricardo Daniel Pepi (born January 9, 2003) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a striker for Eredivisie club PSV and the United States national team.
Ricardo Pepi.note: Pepi stands out for the timing of his run across the nearest defender. He attacks the near-post lane before the marker can turn. In a separate phase, Pepi arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover.
Ricardo Pepi.noteZh: Ricardo Pepi最鲜明的特点是抢到近门柱身前的跑动时机。一个直接线索是他会在盯防者转身前冲向近门柱线路。另一个独立细节是他会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。

Sebastian Berhalter.name: Sebastian Berhalter
Sebastian Berhalter.summary: Sebastian Matthew Berhalter (born May 10, 2001) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Major League Soccer club Vancouver Whitecaps and the United States national team.
Sebastian Berhalter.note: Watch Berhalter for taking responsibility for attacking dead-ball deliveries. The clearest example is how he serves corners and free kicks into the attacking area. Also watch how Berhalter moves into a position where an available pass can lead to a shot.
Sebastian Berhalter.noteZh: 观察Sebastian Berhalter时，可以先看负责进攻定位球的输送。他会把角球和任意球送入进攻区域。另一个比赛细节是他会移动到接球后可以形成射门的位置。

Sergino Dest.name: Sergino Dest
Sergino Dest.summary: Sergiño Gianni Dest (; born November 3, 2000) is a professional soccer player who plays as a full-back for Eredivisie club PSV Eindhoven. Born in the Netherlands, he represents the United States national team.
Sergino Dest.note: For Dest, the foundation is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Look first at how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. A separate point is how he changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target.
Sergino Dest.noteZh: 变向时仍把球控制在脚下是理解Sergiño Dest踢法的关键。先看他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。到了另一个比赛环节，他会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。

Tim Ream.name: Tim Ream
Tim Ream.summary: Timothy Michael Ream (born October 5, 1987) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a center-back or left-back for Major League Soccer club Charlotte and captains the United States national team.
Tim Ream.note: The key to Ream is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. Elsewhere in the game, Ream keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Tim Ream.noteZh: Tim Ream的比赛建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢之上。首先看他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个方面是他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Timothy Weah.name: Timothy Weah
Timothy Weah.summary: Timothy Tarpeh Weah (born February 22, 2000) is an American professional soccer player who plays as a winger or right-back for Ligue 1 club Marseille, on loan from Serie A club Juventus, and the United States national team.
Timothy Weah.note: The key to Weah is explosive speed once open grass appears. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. In another phase, Weah moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Timothy Weah.noteZh: Timothy Weah的优势在于看到空当后的爆发速度。最直接的表现是他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。另一个值得观察的细节是他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Mark McKenzie.name: Mark McKenzie
Mark McKenzie.summary: Mark McKenzie is a United States centre-back from Toulouse who gives the national team recovery defending, clean passing, and aerial control.
Mark McKenzie.note: McKenzie stands out for recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. McKenzie also plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Mark McKenzie.noteZh: Mark McKenzie的比赛建立在第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位之上。首先看他如何提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。另一个方面是他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Alex Arce.name: Alex Arce
Alex Arce.summary: Álex Adrián Arce Barrios (born 16 June 1995) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a striker for Argentine club Independiente Rivadavia and the Paraguay national team.
Alex Arce.note: What separates Arce is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. Arce arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover. A separate detail appears when he pins a defender and creates room for the next runner.
Alex Arce.noteZh: Álex Arce的比赛建立在防线重组前制造干净射门之上。首先看他如何保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。另一个方面是他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。

Alexandro Maidana.name: Alexandro Maidana
Alexandro Maidana.summary: Alexandro Maidana Mendieta (born 26 July 2005) is a Paraguayan professional football player who plays as a left-back for Argentine Primera División club Talleres, and the Paraguay national team.
Alexandro Maidana.note: Maidana stands out for closing the crossing angle without losing the runner. He gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in. In a separate phase, Maidana turns early and closes the runner before the box.
Alexandro Maidana.noteZh: 最能体现Alexandro Maidana特点的是封住传中角度时仍不丢掉跑动者。这一点直接体现在他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。除此之外，他也会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。

Andres Cubas.name: Andres Cubas
Andres Cubas.summary: Adrián Andrés Cubas (born 11 May 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as midfielder for Major League Soccer club Vancouver Whitecaps. Born in Argentina, he plays for the Paraguay national team.
Andres Cubas.note: Cubas's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Watch how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Another detail is how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Andres Cubas.noteZh: 选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢构成Andrés Cubas踢法的核心。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。除此之外，值得留意他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Antonio Sanabria.name: Antonio Sanabria
Antonio Sanabria.summary: Arnaldo Antonio Sanabria Ayala (born 4 March 1996), also known as Tony Sanabria, is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a forward for Serie B club Cremonese and the Paraguay national team.
Antonio Sanabria.note: Watch Sanabria for making the next teammate's action easier. The clearest example is how he protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. Elsewhere, Sanabria starts outside his marker and attacks the dropping ball.
Antonio Sanabria.noteZh: Antonio Sanabria的优势在于让队友下一步处理更轻松。最直接的表现是他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。另一个值得观察的细节是他会从盯防者外侧启动，主动攻击落点。

Braian Ojeda.name: Braian Ojeda
Braian Ojeda.summary: Braian Óscar Ojeda Rodríguez (born 27 June 2000) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Major League Soccer club Orlando City and the Paraguay national team.
Braian Ojeda.note: For Ojeda, the foundation is carrying momentum through open midfield. Look first at how he pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. Also watch how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Braian Ojeda.noteZh: 带球穿过开放中场的推进力是理解Braian Ojeda踢法的关键。先看他如何把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Diego Gomez.name: Diego Gomez
Diego Gomez.summary: Diego Gómez is a Paraguay central midfielder from Brighton & Hove Albion who gives the national team powerful carrying, midfield shooting, and box-to-box range.
Diego Gomez.note: The key to Gómez is carrying momentum through open midfield. He pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. In another phase, Gómez shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Diego Gomez.noteZh: Diego Gómez的比赛建立在带球穿过开放中场的推进力之上。首先看他如何把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。另一个方面是他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Fabian Balbuena.name: Fabian Balbuena
Fabian Balbuena.summary: Fabián Cornelio Balbuena González (born 23 August 1991) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Grêmio and the Paraguay national team.
Fabian Balbuena.note: Balbuena's signature is reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. Watch how he steps toward the flight and heads clear before the forward can set himself. Away from that moment, he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Fabian Balbuena.noteZh: 争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹是理解Fabián Balbuena踢法的关键。先看他如何迎向来球，在前锋站稳前头球解围。到了另一个比赛环节，他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Gabriel Avalos.name: Gabriel Avalos
Gabriel Avalos.summary: Gabriel Ávalos Stumpfs (born 9 July 1991) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a striker for Argentine Primera División club Independiente and the Paraguay national team.
Gabriel Avalos.note: The key to Ávalos is reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He starts outside his marker and attacks the dropping ball. Elsewhere in the game, Ávalos pins a defender and creates room for the next runner.
Gabriel Avalos.noteZh: Gabriel Ávalos最鲜明的特点是争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。一个直接线索是他会从盯防者外侧启动，主动攻击落点。另一个独立细节是他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。

Gaston Olveira.name: Gaston Olveira
Gaston Olveira.summary: Gastón Hernán Olveira Echeverría (born 21 April 1993) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Paraguayan Primera División club Club Olimpia. Born in Uruguay, he plays for the Paraguay national team.
Gaston Olveira.note: For Olveira, the foundation is command of the crowded space around goal. Look first at how he attacks the cross at the highest point he can control before traffic closes. Separately, look at how he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Gaston Olveira.noteZh: 看Gastón Olveira的作用，关键是掌控门前拥挤空间的能力。他会在人群合拢前迎向传中，并在最高可控点处理来球。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Gatito Fernandez.name: Gatito Fernandez
Gatito Fernandez.summary: Roberto Júnior Fernández Torres (born 29 March 1988), better known as Gatito Fernández, is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Paraguayan Primera División club Cerro Porteño and the Paraguay national team.
Gatito Fernandez.note: What separates Fernández is staying ready through long quiet spells. Fernández keeps his decisions calm when a sudden save is required. At another point, he leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Gatito Fernandez.noteZh: 看Gatito Fernández的作用，关键是长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。他会在突然需要扑救时仍能冷静判断。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Gustavo Caballero.name: Gustavo Caballero
Gustavo Caballero.summary: Gustavo Rubén Caballero González (born 21 September 2001) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays for EFL Championship club Portsmouth, on loan from Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Santos, and the Paraguay national team.
Gustavo Caballero.note: Watch Caballero for starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. The clearest example is how he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. A separate clue is how Caballero angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Gustavo Caballero.noteZh: 最能体现Gustavo Caballero特点的是防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。这一点直接体现在他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。除此之外，他也会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Gustavo Velazquez.name: Gustavo Velazquez
Gustavo Velazquez.summary: Víctor Gustavo Velázquez Ramos (born 17 April 1991) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Cerro Porteño and the Paraguay national team.
Gustavo Velazquez.note: Velázquez stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. A different detail is how Velázquez holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Gustavo Velazquez.noteZh: 观察Gustavo Velázquez时，可以先看选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个比赛细节是他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Isidro Pitta.name: Isidro Pitta
Isidro Pitta.summary: Isidro Miguel Pitta Saldivar (born 14 August 1999) is a Paraguayan footballer who plays as a forward for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Red Bull Bragantino and the Paraguay national team.
Isidro Pitta.note: The key to Pitta is starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. A separate part of his game is how Pitta protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Isidro Pitta.noteZh: 最能体现Isidro Pitta特点的是防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。这一点直接体现在他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。除此之外，他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Jose Canale.name: Jose Canale
Jose Canale.summary: José María Canale Domínguez (born 20 July 1996) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Argentine Primera División side Lanús and the Paraguay national team.
Jose Canale.note: Watch Canale for making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. The clearest example is how he protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. A separate clue is how Canale moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Jose Canale.noteZh: José Canale的优势在于对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。最直接的表现是他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。另一个值得观察的细节是他会迎向落下的球，在对手站稳前参与争抢。

Juan Jose Caceres.name: Juan Jose Caceres
Juan Jose Caceres.summary: Juan José Cáceres (born 1 June 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Russian Premier League club Dynamo Moscow. Born in Argentina, he plays for the Paraguay national team.
Juan Jose Caceres.note: Cáceres's signature is closing the crossing angle without losing the runner. Watch how he gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in. He also waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Juan Jose Caceres.noteZh: 看Juan José Cáceres的作用，关键是封住传中角度时仍不丢掉跑动者。他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Junior Alonso.name: Junior Alonso
Junior Alonso.summary: Júnior Osmar Ignacio Alonso Mujica (born 9 February 1993) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a defender or left-back for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Atlético Mineiro and the Paraguay national team.
Junior Alonso.note: Alonso stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. In a separate phase, Alonso meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Junior Alonso.noteZh: 理解Júnior Alonso，要先看先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Omar Alderete.name: Omar Alderete
Omar Alderete.summary: Omar Federico Alderete Fernández (born 26 December 1996) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a defender for Premier League club Sunderland and the Paraguay national team. Mainly a centre-back, he can also play as a left-back.
Omar Alderete.note: For Alderete, the foundation is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Look first at how he takes the first available forward lane before it closes. A separate point is how he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Omar Alderete.noteZh: Omar Alderete最鲜明的特点是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。一个直接线索是他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。另一个独立细节是他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Orlando Gill.name: Orlando Gill
Orlando Gill.summary: Orlando Daniel Gill Noldin (born 11 June 2000) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for the Argentine Primera División club San Lorenzo and the Paraguay national team.
Orlando Gill.note: What separates Gill is keeping his body shape compact for reflex saves at close range. Gill keeps his hands and feet connected so the reflex block stays controlled. In another phase, watch whether he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Orlando Gill.noteZh: 最能体现Orlando Gill特点的是近距离反应扑救时保持紧凑身体姿态。这一点直接体现在他会让手脚保持联动，使本能挡球也能控制方向。接着可以问，他是否会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Ramon Sosa.name: Ramon Sosa
Ramon Sosa.summary: Ramón Sosa Acosta (born 31 August 1999) is a Paraguayan professional footballer who plays as a winger for Campeonato Brasileiro Série A club Palmeiras, and the Paraguay national team.
Ramon Sosa.note: Watch Sosa for explosive speed once open grass appears. The clearest example is how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Elsewhere, Sosa pulls the ball back from near the end line toward a supporting runner.
Ramon Sosa.noteZh: 看到空当后的爆发速度是理解Ramón Sosa踢法的关键。先看他如何等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。到了另一个比赛环节，他会接近底线后把球回传给后排接应的队友。

Kaku.name: Kaku
Kaku.summary: Kaku is a Paraguay attacking midfielder from Al-Ain who gives the national team left-footed creativity, final passes, and set-piece service.
Kaku.note: The key to Kaku is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. A separate part of his game is how Kaku varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Kaku.noteZh: 看Kaku的作用，关键是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Aiden Oneill.name: Aiden Oneill
Aiden Oneill.summary: Aiden Connor O'Neill (born 4 July 1998) is an Australian professional soccer player who currently plays as a defensive midfielder for New York City FC and the Australia national team.
Aiden Oneill.note: O'Neill's signature is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Watch how he takes the first available forward lane before it closes. Separately, he positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over.
Aiden Oneill.noteZh: 理解Aiden O'Neill，要先看用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会在第一次争抢还没结束时，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。

Ajdin Hrustic.name: Ajdin Hrustic
Ajdin Hrustic.summary: Ajdin Hrustic (Bosnian: [ǎjdin xrǔstitɕ] EYE-din HROO-stich; born 5 July 1996) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a midfielder for Eerste Divisie club Heracles Almelo and the Australia national team.
Ajdin Hrustic.note: Watch Hrustić for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. The clearest example is how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. A separate clue is how Hrustić plays the available pass with his left foot.
Ajdin Hrustic.noteZh: 压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定是理解Ajdin Hrustić踢法的关键。先看他如何在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。到了另一个比赛环节，他会用左脚送出眼前可行的传球。

Alessandro Circati.name: Alessandro Circati
Alessandro Circati.summary: Alessandro Circati (Italian: [alesˈsandro tʃirˈkaːti]; born 10 October 2003) is a professional soccer player who plays as a central defender for Serie A club Parma.
Alessandro Circati.note: What separates Circati is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Circati takes the first available forward lane before it closes. Away from that action, he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Alessandro Circati.noteZh: 最能体现Alessandro Circati特点的是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。这一点直接体现在他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。除此之外，他也会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Awer Mabil.name: Awer Mabil
Awer Mabil.summary: Awer Bul Mabil (born 15 September 1995) is a professional soccer player who plays as a winger for Segunda División club CD Castellón. Born in a Kenyan refugee camp to South Sudanese parents, he plays for the Australia national team.
Awer Mabil.note: The key to Mabil is explosive speed once open grass appears. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. Elsewhere in the game, Mabil moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Awer Mabil.noteZh: 观察Awer Mabil时，可以先看看到空当后的爆发速度。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。另一个比赛细节是他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Aziz Behich.name: Aziz Behich
Aziz Behich.summary: Aziz Behich (Turkish: [aˈziz eɾaɫˈtaj beˈhit͡ʃ], AZ-iz BAY-itch; born 16 December 1990) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a left back for A-League Men club Melbourne City and the Australia national team.
Aziz Behich.note: For Behich, the foundation is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Look first at how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Beyond that, watch how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Aziz Behich.noteZh: 最能体现Aziz Behich特点的是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。这一点直接体现在他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。除此之外，他也会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Cameron Devlin.name: Cameron Devlin
Cameron Devlin.summary: Cammy Devlin is an Australia central midfielder from Heart of Midlothian who gives the national team ball-winning bite, pressing range, and combative energy.
Cameron Devlin.note: Devlin stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. In a separate phase, Devlin angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Cameron Devlin.noteZh: Cammy Devlin最鲜明的特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。一个直接线索是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个独立细节是他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Harry Souttar.name: Harry Souttar
Harry Souttar.summary: Harry James Souttar (born 22 October 1998) is a professional soccer player who plays as a centre-back for EFL League One club Leicester City. Born in Scotland, he plays for the Australia national team.
Harry Souttar.note: The key to Souttar is reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. There is another side to his game: he holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Harry Souttar.noteZh: 争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹构成Harry Souttar踢法的核心。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。除此之外，值得留意他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Jacob Italiano.name: Jacob Italiano
Jacob Italiano.summary: Jacob Michael Italiano (born 30 July 2001) is an Australian professional football player who plays as a right back for Austrian Bundesliga club Grazer AK and the Australia national team.
Jacob Italiano.note: For Italiano, the foundation is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Look first at how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Also watch how he turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Jacob Italiano.noteZh: 观察Jacob Italiano时，可以先看从后场加入进攻的启动时机。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个比赛细节是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Jason Geria.name: Jason Geria
Jason Geria.summary: Jason Kato Geria (born 10 May 1993) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a defender for Albirex Niigata in the J2 League and the Australia national team.
Jason Geria.note: What separates Geria is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Geria holds the route into the box until support arrives. At another point, he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Jason Geria.noteZh: 先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢构成Jason Geria踢法的核心。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。除此之外，值得留意他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Jordan Bos.name: Jordan Bos
Jordan Bos.summary: Jordan Jacob Bos (born 29 October 2002) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a left back for Eredivisie side Feyenoord and the Australia national team.
Jordan Bos.note: Watch Bos for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. The clearest example is how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Elsewhere, Bos turns early and closes the runner before the box.
Jordan Bos.noteZh: Bos的优势在于从后场加入进攻的启动时机。最直接的表现是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个值得观察的细节是他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。

Kai Trewin.name: Kai Trewin
Kai Trewin.summary: Kai Clifton Trewin (; born 18 May 2001) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a central defender for Major League Soccer club New York City FC and the Australia national team.
Kai Trewin.note: Trewin stands out for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. Trewin also holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Kai Trewin.noteZh: 最能体现Kai Trewin特点的是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。这一点直接体现在他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。除此之外，他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Lucas Herrington.name: Lucas Herrington
Lucas Herrington.summary: Lucas Herrington (born 5 September 2007) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a central defender for Major League Soccer club Colorado Rapids and the Australia national team.
Lucas Herrington.note: Herrington's signature is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. Watch how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. Separately, he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Lucas Herrington.noteZh: Lucas Herrington的比赛建立在压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定之上。首先看他如何在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。另一个方面是他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Mathew Leckie.name: Mathew Leckie
Mathew Leckie.summary: Mathew Allan Leckie (born 4 February 1991) is an Australian soccer player who plays for A-League club Melbourne City and the Australia national team (whom he previously captained). Leckie, being a quick and agile player, is usually placed on the wing.
Mathew Leckie.note: Leckie stands out for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. A different detail is how Leckie angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Mathew Leckie.noteZh: 最能体现Mathew Leckie特点的是有目的地进行无球移动。这一点直接体现在他会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。除此之外，他也会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Milos Degenek.name: Milos Degenek
Milos Degenek.summary: Miloš Degenek ( MIL-osh DEG-ə-nek; Serbian Cyrillic: Милош Дегенек, born 28 April 1994) is a professional soccer player who plays as a centre-back for Cypriot First Division club APOEL. Born in Croatia, he represents the Australia national team.
Milos Degenek.note: What separates Degenek is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. Degenek changes position while keeping his priorities simple. Away from that action, he slows the play to restore control and takes the risk once the opening is clear.
Milos Degenek.noteZh: 看Miloš Degenek的作用，关键是多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Mohamed Toure.name: Mohamed Toure
Mohamed Toure.summary: Mohamed Touré is an Australia centre-forward from Norwich City who gives the national team pace, penalty-box finishing, and direct channel runs.
Mohamed Toure.note: The key to Touré is explosive speed once open grass appears. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. In another phase, Touré arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover.
Mohamed Toure.noteZh: 最能体现Mohamed Touré特点的是看到空当后的爆发速度。这一点直接体现在他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。除此之外，他也会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。

Nishan Velupillay.name: Nishan Velupillay
Nishan Velupillay.summary: Nishan Matthew Velupillay (Tamil: நிஷான் மேத்யூ வேலுப்பிள்ளை, pronounced [niːʃɑːn ʋeːlupːiɭɭai]; born 7 May 2001) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a winger for Melbourne Victory and the Australia national team.
Nishan Velupillay.note: Velupillay's signature is arriving at the far side after defenders have narrowed toward the ball. Watch how he holds the far-post lane, then attacks it as the cross leaves the passer. He also changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Nishan Velupillay.noteZh: Nishan Velupillay的比赛建立在等防守者向球侧收缩后再到达后点之上。首先看他如何先留在后点线路，等传中离脚后再启动攻击落点。另一个方面是他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Patrick Beach.name: Patrick Beach
Patrick Beach.summary: Patrick Thomas Beach (born 6 August 2003) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for A-League Men club Melbourne City and the Australia national team.
Patrick Beach.note: Watch Beach for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. The clearest example is how he sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. A separate clue is how Beach leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Patrick Beach.noteZh: Patrick Beach的优势在于提前站位后的快速反应。最直接的表现是他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。另一个值得观察的细节是他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Paul Izzo.name: Paul Izzo
Paul Izzo.summary: Paul David Izzo (Italian: [ˈittso]; born 6 January 1995) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for Danish Superliga side Randers and the Australia national team. He was selected to play in the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
Paul Izzo.note: For Izzo, the foundation is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. Look first at how he sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. For a wider picture, notice whether he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Paul Izzo.noteZh: 提前站位后的快速反应是理解Paul Izzo踢法的关键。先看他如何在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。另一个问题是，Paul Izzo是否会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Paul Okon-Engstler.name: Paul Okon-Engstler
Paul Okon-Engstler.summary: Paul Michael Junior Okon-Engstler (West Flemish: [ˈoːkɔn ˈɛŋstlər]: born 24 January 2005), also known as Paul Okon Junior, is a professional soccer player who plays as a defensive midfielder for Sydney FC in the A-League Men.
Paul Okon-Engstler.note: Okon-Engstler stands out for keeping possession moving with the available pass. He moves the ball to the next available teammate without holding it. Okon-Engstler also plays forward toward an available runner when the opening appears.
Paul Okon-Engstler.noteZh: Paul Okon-Engstler的比赛建立在用眼前可行的传球保持球权流动之上。首先看他如何不拖延持球，把球交给下一名可接应的队友。另一个方面是他会线路出现时向前送给可接应的跑动者。

Tete Yengi.name: Tete Yengi
Tete Yengi.summary: Tete Owen Yengi (born 28 November 2000) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a striker for J1 League club Machida Zelvia, on loan from Scottish Championship club Livingston, and the Australia national team.
Tete Yengi.note: Watch Yengi for using strength without slowing the next action. The clearest example is how he absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. Elsewhere, Yengi moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Tete Yengi.noteZh: 理解Tete Yengi，要先看对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步。他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Alexander Sorloth.name: Alexander Sorloth
Alexander Sorloth.summary: Alexander Sørloth (born 5 December 1995) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a striker for La Liga club Atlético Madrid and the Norway national team.
Alexander Sorloth.note: Watch Sørloth for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. The clearest example is how he shifts onto his left foot and shoots with little backlift. Also watch how Sørloth pins a defender and creates room for the next runner.
Alexander Sorloth.noteZh: 最能体现Alexander Sørloth特点的是防线重组前制造干净射门。这一点直接体现在他会把球调整到左脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。除此之外，他也会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。

Andreas Schjelderup.name: Andreas Schjelderup
Andreas Schjelderup.summary: Andreas Rædergård Schjelderup (born 1 June 2004) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a left winger or forward for Primeira Liga club Benfica and the Norway national team.
Andreas Schjelderup.note: Schjelderup's signature is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Watch how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. At another point in the move, he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Andreas Schjelderup.noteZh: 理解Andreas Schjelderup，要先看比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Egil Selvik.name: Egil Selvik
Egil Selvik.summary: Egil Selvik (born 30 July 1997) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Watford and the Norway national team.
Egil Selvik.note: What separates Selvik is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. Selvik sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. A separate detail appears when he leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Egil Selvik.noteZh: 提前站位后的快速反应是理解Egil Selvik踢法的关键。先看他如何在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。到了另一个比赛环节，他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Fredrik Andre Bjorkan.name: Fredrik Andre Bjorkan
Fredrik Andre Bjorkan.summary: Fredrik André Bjørkan (born 21 August 1998) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Eliteserien club Bodø/Glimt and the Norway national team.
Fredrik Andre Bjorkan.note: The key to Bjørkan is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. A separate part of his game is how Bjørkan turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Fredrik Andre Bjorkan.noteZh: Fredrik André Bjørkan的比赛建立在从后场加入进攻的启动时机之上。首先看他如何等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个方面是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Fredrik Aursnes.name: Fredrik Aursnes
Fredrik Aursnes.summary: Fredrik Aursnes (born 10 December 1995) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays primarily as a midfielder for Primeira Liga club Benfica and the Norway national team.
Fredrik Aursnes.note: Aursnes stands out for reading the next phase before the space fully opens. He adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple. Aursnes also holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Fredrik Aursnes.noteZh: 空当完全出现前读懂下一阶段构成Fredrik Aursnes踢法的核心。他会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。除此之外，值得留意他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Henrik Falchener.name: Henrik Falchener
Henrik Falchener.summary: Henrik Sælebakke Falchener (born 8 May 2003) is a Norwegian footballer who plays as a centre-back for Viking and the Norway national team.
Henrik Falchener.note: For Falchener, the foundation is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Look first at how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. Beyond the first action, he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Henrik Falchener.noteZh: 看Henrik Falchener的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会迎向落下的球，在对手站稳前参与争抢。

Jens Petter Hauge.name: Jens Petter Hauge
Jens Petter Hauge.summary: Jens Petter Hauge (born 12 October 1999) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Eliteserien club Bodø/Glimt and the Norway national team.
Jens Petter Hauge.note: Hauge stands out for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. Also look at how Hauge shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Jens Petter Hauge.noteZh: 理解Jens Petter Hauge，要先看变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Kristian Thorstvedt.name: Kristian Thorstvedt
Kristian Thorstvedt.summary: Kristian Thorstvedt (born 13 March 1999) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Sassuolo and the Norway national team.
Kristian Thorstvedt.note: What separates Thorstvedt is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. Thorstvedt arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. In another phase of play, he shifts onto his left foot and shoots with little backlift.
Kristian Thorstvedt.noteZh: 等防守者注意力转移后再启动构成Kristian Thorstvedt踢法的核心。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。除此之外，值得留意他会把球调整到左脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Kristoffer Ajer.name: Kristoffer Ajer
Kristoffer Ajer.summary: Kristoffer Vassbakk Köpp Ajer (born 17 April 1998) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays either as centre-back or right-back for Premier League club Brentford and the Norway national team.
Kristoffer Ajer.note: Watch Ajer for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. The clearest example is how he changes position while keeping his priorities simple. Also watch how Ajer draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Kristoffer Ajer.noteZh: Kristoffer Ajer最鲜明的特点是多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。一个直接线索是他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。另一个独立细节是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Morten Thorsby.name: Morten Thorsby
Morten Thorsby.summary: Morten Thorsby (born 5 May 1996) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Serie B club Cremonese and the Norway national team.
Morten Thorsby.note: The key to Thorsby is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. A separate part of his game is how Thorsby positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over.
Morten Thorsby.noteZh: 观察Morten Thorsby时，可以先看选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个比赛细节是他会在第一次争抢还没结束时，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。

Orjan Nyland.name: Orjan Nyland
Orjan Nyland.summary: Ørjan Nyland is a Norway goalkeeper from Sevilla FC who gives the national team veteran shot stopping, box command, and tournament experience.
Orjan Nyland.note: For Nyland, the foundation is protecting the centre before the shooter reveals the finish. Look first at how he sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot. Separately, look at how he leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Orjan Nyland.noteZh: Ørjan Nyland的比赛建立在射手暴露射门方向前先守住球门中央之上。首先看他如何提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。另一个方面是他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Oscar Bobb.name: Oscar Bobb
Oscar Bobb.summary: Oscar Bobb (born 12 July 2003) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or winger for Premier League club Fulham and the Norway national team.
Oscar Bobb.note: Bobb's signature is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Watch how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. Another detail is how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Oscar Bobb.noteZh: Oscar Bobb的比赛建立在比防线早一步看到决定性的传球之上。首先看他如何先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。另一个方面是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Patrick Berg.name: Patrick Berg
Patrick Berg.summary: Patrick Berg (born 24 November 1997) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Eliteserien club Bodø/Glimt and the Norway national team.
Patrick Berg.note: Berg stands out for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. A different question is whether he pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it.
Patrick Berg.noteZh: 最能体现Patrick Berg特点的是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。这一点直接体现在他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。接着可以问，他是否会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。

Sander Berge.name: Sander Berge
Sander Berge.summary: Sander Gard Bolin Berge also known as Sandy Berge (born 14 February 1998) is a Norwegian professional footballer from Asker who plays as a defensive midfielder for Premier League club Fulham and the Norway national team.
Sander Berge.note: What separates Berge is carrying momentum through open midfield. Berge pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. A separate detail appears when he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Sander Berge.noteZh: 带球穿过开放中场的推进力构成Sander Berge踢法的核心。他会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。除此之外，值得留意他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Sander Tangvik.name: Sander Tangvik

Sander Tangvik.noteZh: 把一次扑救变成进攻第一传是理解Sander Tangvik踢法的关键。先看他如何在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。到了另一个比赛环节，他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Sondre Langas.name: Sondre Langas
Sondre Langas.summary: Sondre Klingen Langås (born 2 February 2001) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Derby County and the Norway national team. Langås made his debut in the Norwegian Eliteserien for Viking.

Sondre Langas.noteZh: 对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择构成Sondre Langås踢法的核心。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。除此之外，值得留意他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Torbjorn Heggem.name: Torbjorn Heggem
Torbjorn Heggem.summary: Torbjørn Lysaker Heggem (born 12 January 1999) is a Norwegian footballer who plays as a defender for Serie A club Bologna and the Norway national team. Primarily a centre-back, Heggem can also play as a left-back.
Torbjorn Heggem.note: Heggem's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Watch how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. Away from that moment, he checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives.

David Moller Wolfe.name: David Moller Wolfe

David Moller Wolfe.note: Wolfe stands out for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. Another aspect is how Wolfe turns early and protects the route toward goal.

Jorgen Strand Larsen.name: Jorgen Strand Larsen
Jorgen Strand Larsen.summary: Jørgen Strand Larsen (Norwegian: [ˈjøːɾɡən strɑn ˈlɑːɾsən], born 6 February 2000) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Premier League club Crystal Palace and the Norway national team.
Jorgen Strand Larsen.note: What separates Larsen is making the next teammate's action easier. Larsen protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. Also note how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Jorgen Strand Larsen.noteZh: 观察Jørgen Strand Larsen时，可以先看让队友下一步处理更轻松。他会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。另一个比赛细节是他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Adrien Rabiot.name: Adrien Rabiot
Adrien Rabiot.summary: Adrien Thibault Marie Rabiot (French pronunciation: [adʁijɛ̃ tibo maʁi ʁabjo]; born 3 April 1995) is a French professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club AC Milan and the France national team.
Adrien Rabiot.note: Rabiot's signature is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. Watch how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. He also meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Adrien Rabiot.noteZh: 最能体现Adrien Rabiot特点的是等防守者注意力转移后再启动。这一点直接体现在他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。除此之外，他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Aurelien Tchouameni.name: Aurelien Tchouameni
Aurelien Tchouameni.summary: Aurélien Djani Tchouaméni (French pronunciation: [oʁeljɛ̃ dʒani tʃuameni, tʃwa-]; born 27 January 2000) is a French professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder or a centre-back for La Liga club Real Madrid and the France national team.
Aurelien Tchouameni.note: What separates Tchouaméni is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Tchouaméni plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. In another phase of play, he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Aurelien Tchouameni.noteZh: Aurélien Tchouaméni的比赛建立在用传球的力度和角度移动防线之上。首先看他如何穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。另一个方面是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Brice Samba.note: Samba's signature is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. Watch how he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. Separately, he sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step.

Ibrahima Konate.summary: Ibrahima Konaté (French pronunciation: [ibʁaimˈa konatˈe]; born 25 May 1999) is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Liverpool and the France national team.

Jean-Philippe Mateta.name: Jean-Philippe Mateta
Jean-Philippe Mateta.summary: Jean-Philippe Mateta (born 28 June 1997) is a French professional footballer who plays as a striker for Premier League club Crystal Palace and the France national team.
Jean-Philippe Mateta.note: For Mateta, the foundation is giving centre-backs a physical problem they cannot ignore. Look first at how he pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. Separately, look at how he arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover.
Jean-Philippe Mateta.noteZh: Jean-Philippe Mateta的比赛建立在让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用之上。首先看他如何牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。另一个方面是他会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。

Lucas Hernandez.name: Lucas Hernandez

Manu Kone.name: Manu Kone
Manu Kone.summary: Kouadio Emmanuel Boris Koné (born 17 May 2001) is a French professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Serie A club Roma and the France national team.

Marcus Thuram.name: Marcus Thuram
