Mohamed Alaa.name: Mohamed Alaa
Mohamed Alaa.summary: Mohamed Alaaeldin Soliman M Ahmed (محمد علاء الدين سليمان أحمد; born 1 January 1999) is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Egyptian Premier League club El Gouna and the Egypt national team.
Mohamed Alaa.note: For Alaa, the foundation is protecting the centre before the shooter reveals the finish. Look first at how he sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot. For a wider picture, notice whether he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Mohamed Alaa.noteZh: 最能体现Mohamed Alaa特点的是射手暴露射门方向前先守住球门中央。这一点直接体现在他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。接着可以问，他是否会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Mohamed El Shenawy.name: Mohamed El Shenawy
Mohamed El Shenawy.summary: Mohamed El Sayed Mohamed El Shenawy Gomaa (Arabic: محمد السيد محمد الشناوي جمعة; born 18 December 1988) is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Egyptian Premier League club Al Ahly, which he captains, and the Egypt national team.
Mohamed El Shenawy.note: Watch El Shenawy for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. The clearest example is how he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. A separate clue is how El Shenawy keeps his decisions calm when a sudden save is required.
Mohamed El Shenawy.noteZh: 危险出现前组织好队友是理解Mohamed El Shenawy踢法的关键。先看他如何用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在突然需要扑救时仍能冷静判断。

Mohanad Lashin.name: Mohanad Lashin
Mohanad Lashin.summary: Mohanad Lashin is an Egypt defensive midfielder from Pyramids FC who gives the national team central coverage, ball winning, and simple progression.
Mohanad Lashin.note: What separates Lasheen is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Lasheen waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Away from that action, he takes the first available forward lane before it closes.
Mohanad Lashin.noteZh: 观察Mohanad Lasheen时，可以先看选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个比赛细节是他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。

Mostafa Shoubir.name: Mostafa Shoubir
Mostafa Shoubir.summary: Mostafa Shoubir is an Egypt goalkeeper from Al Ahly who gives the national team reaction saves, line command, and close-range stops.
Mostafa Shoubir.note: The key to Shobeir is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. One more thing to notice is how Shobeir keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Mostafa Shoubir.noteZh: 看Mostafa Shobeir的作用，关键是提前站位后的快速反应。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Nabil Donga.name: Nabil Donga
Nabil Donga.summary: Nabil Emad Aly Elmahdy (Arabic: نبيل عماد علي المهدي; born 6 April 1996) also known as Donga (Arabic: دونجا), is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Saudi Pro League club Al-Najma and the Egypt national team.
Nabil Donga.note: For Emad, the foundation is reacting first when a duel leaves the ball free. Look first at how he positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. Separately, look at how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Nabil Donga.noteZh: 观察Nabil Emad时，可以先看对抗后球权松动时的第一反应。他会在第一次争抢还没结束时，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。另一个比赛细节是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Ramy Rabia.name: Ramy Rabia
Ramy Rabia.summary: Ramy Hisham Abdel Aziz Mostafa Rabia (Arabic: رامي هشام عبد العزيز مصطفى ربيعة; born 20 May 1993) is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for UAE Pro League club Al Ain and the Egypt national team.
Ramy Rabia.note: Rabia stands out for reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He steps toward the flight and heads clear before the forward can set himself. Rabia also slows the play to restore control and takes the risk once the opening is clear.
Ramy Rabia.noteZh: Ramy Rabia最鲜明的特点是争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。一个直接线索是他会迎向来球，在前锋站稳前头球解围。另一个独立细节是他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Tarek Alaa.name: Tarek Alaa
Tarek Alaa.summary: Tarek Alaa is an Egypt right-back from ZED FC who gives the national team right-side defending, overlap energy, and recovery runs.
Tarek Alaa.note: Alaa's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Watch how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. Away from that moment, he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Tarek Alaa.noteZh: Tarek Alaa的比赛建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢之上。首先看他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个方面是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Yasser Ibrahim.name: Yasser Ibrahim
Yasser Ibrahim.summary: Yasser Ibrahim Ahmed El Hanafi (Arabic: يَاسِر إبرَاهِيْم أَحمَد الْحَنَفِي; born 10 February 1993) is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Egyptian Premier League club Al Ahly and the Egypt national team.
Yasser Ibrahim.note: What separates Ibrahim is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. Ibrahim protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. Away from that action, he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Yasser Ibrahim.noteZh: Yasser Ibrahim的比赛建立在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择之上。首先看他如何先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。另一个方面是他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Zizo.name: Zizo
Zizo.summary: Ahmed Mostafa Mohamed Sayed (Arabic: أحمد مصطفى محمد سيد; born 10 January 1996) commonly known as Zizo (Arabic: زيزو), is an Egyptian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Egyptian Premier League club Al Ahly and the Egypt national team.
Zizo.note: Zizo stands out for delivering the ball without needing much space. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. In a separate phase, Zizo varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Zizo.noteZh: Zizo最鲜明的特点是很小空间里也能送出传中的能力。一个直接线索是他会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。另一个独立细节是他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Ali Alipour.name: Ali Alipour
Ali Alipour.summary: Ali Alipour (Persian: علی علیپور; born 11 November 1995) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a Striker for Persian Gulf Pro League club Persepolis and the Iran national team.
Ali Alipour.note: What separates Alipour is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. Alipour arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Away from that action, he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Ali Alipour.noteZh: 等防守者注意力转移后再启动是理解Ali Alipour踢法的关键。先看他如何稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Ali Nemati.name: Ali Nemati
Ali Nemati.summary: Ali Nemati is an IR Iran centre-back from Foolad FC who gives the national team left-footed defending, aerial cover, and back-line depth.
Ali Nemati.note: What separates Nemati is staying connected to runners when the ball moves elsewhere. Nemati checks the runner over his shoulder before the final pass arrives. Also note how he turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Ali Nemati.noteZh: Ali Nemati的比赛建立在球转移到别处时仍能跟住无球跑动之上。首先看他如何在最后一传到来前回头确认跑动者的位置。另一个方面是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Alireza Beiranvand.name: Alireza Beiranvand
Alireza Beiranvand.summary: Alireza Safar Beiranvand (born 21 September 1992) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for the Persian Gulf Pro League club Tractor and the Iran national team.
Alireza Beiranvand.note: Beiranvand stands out for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. In a separate phase, Beiranvand chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Alireza Beiranvand.noteZh: 危险出现前组织好队友是理解Alireza Beiranvand踢法的关键。先看他如何用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh.name: Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh
Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh.summary: Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh is an IR Iran forward from Tractor FC who gives the national team quick turns, final-third carrying, and attacking spark.
Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh.note: The key to Hosseinzadeh is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. Elsewhere in the game, Hosseinzadeh opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward.
Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh.noteZh: 理解Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh，要先看变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会在第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。

Amirmohammad Razaghinia.name: Amirmohammad Razaghinia
Amirmohammad Razaghinia.summary: Amirmohammad Razzaghinia is an IR Iran central midfielder from Esteghlal FC who gives the national team midfield legs, duel pressure, and simple progression.
Amirmohammad Razaghinia.note: Watch Razzaghinia for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. The clearest example is how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Also watch how Razzaghinia takes the first available forward lane before it closes.
Amirmohammad Razaghinia.noteZh: Amirmohammad Razzaghinia最鲜明的特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。一个直接线索是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个独立细节是他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。

Arya Yousefi.name: Arya Yousefi
Arya Yousefi.summary: Arya Yousefi is an IR Iran right-back from Sepahan FC who gives the national team overlap timing, recovery defending, and right-side energy.
Arya Yousefi.note: Yousefi's signature is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Watch how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He also turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Arya Yousefi.noteZh: Arya Yousefi最鲜明的特点是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。一个直接线索是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个独立细节是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Danial Iri.name: Danial Iri
Danial Iri.summary: Danial Eiri is an IR Iran centre-back from Malavan Bandar Anzali who gives the national team centre-back depth, aerial defending, and box protection.
Danial Iri.note: For Eiri, the foundation is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Look first at how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. Beyond that, watch how he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Danial Iri.noteZh: Danial Eiri的优势在于先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。最直接的表现是他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个值得观察的细节是他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Dennis Dargahi.name: Dennis Dargahi
Dennis Dargahi.summary: Dennis Yerai Eckert Ayensa (born 9 January 1997), also known as Dennis Dargahi, is a professional footballer who plays as a forward and midfielder for Standard Liège in the Belgian Pro League.
Dennis Dargahi.note: For Ayensa, the foundation is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. Look first at how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Beyond that, watch how he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Dennis Dargahi.noteZh: 带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑构成Dennis Eckert Ayensa踢法的核心。他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。除此之外，值得留意他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Ehsan Hajisafi.name: Ehsan Hajisafi
Ehsan Hajisafi.summary: Ehsan Hajsafi (Persian: احسان حاج‌صفی; born 25 February 1990) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays for Sepahan and the Iran national team. Hajsafi is regarded as a utility player, being able to play as a winger, left-back or defensive midfielder.
Ehsan Hajisafi.note: Hajsafi's signature is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. Watch how he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. He also holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Ehsan Hajisafi.noteZh: 最能体现Ehsan Hajsafi特点的是危险出现前组织好队友。这一点直接体现在他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。除此之外，他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Hossein Hosseini.name: Hossein Hosseini
Hossein Hosseini.summary: Seyed Hossein Hosseini (Persian: سید حسین حسینی; born 30 June 1992) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Persian Gulf Pro League club Sepahan and the Iran national team.
Hossein Hosseini.note: The key to Hosseini is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. One more thing to notice is how Hosseini leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Hossein Hosseini.noteZh: Hossein Hosseini的优势在于提前站位后的快速反应。最直接的表现是他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。另一个值得观察的细节是他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Hossein Kanani.name: Hossein Kanani
Hossein Kanani.summary: Mohammad Hossein Kanaanizadegan (Persian: محمد حسین کنعانی زادگان; born 23 March 1994), known as Hossein Kanaani, is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Persian Gulf Pro League club Persepolis and Iran national team.
Hossein Kanani.note: Kanaanizadegan stands out for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Kanaanizadegan also meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Hossein Kanani.noteZh: 选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢构成Hossein Kanaanizadegan踢法的核心。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。除此之外，值得留意他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Mehdi Ghayedi.name: Mehdi Ghayedi
Mehdi Ghayedi.summary: Mehdi Ghayedi is an IR Iran winger from Al-Nasr SC who gives the national team low-centre turns, inside shots, and left-wing dribbling.
Mehdi Ghayedi.note: What separates Ghayedi is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Ghayedi draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. At another point, he arrives balanced and finishes before the nearest defender can recover.
Mehdi Ghayedi.noteZh: Mehdi Ghayedi的优势在于变向时仍把球控制在脚下。最直接的表现是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。另一个值得观察的细节是他会保持身体平衡，在最近防守者回位前完成射门。

Mehdi Torabi.name: Mehdi Torabi
Mehdi Torabi.summary: Mahdi Torabi (born 10 September 1994) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Persian Gulf Pro League club Tractor and the Iran national team.
Mehdi Torabi.note: Watch Torabi for delivering the ball without needing much space. The clearest example is how he looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. Also watch how Torabi starts outside his marker and attacks the dropping ball.
Mehdi Torabi.noteZh: 很小空间里也能送出传中的能力构成Mahdi Torabi踢法的核心。他会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。除此之外，值得留意他会从盯防者外侧启动，主动攻击落点。

Milad Mohammadi.name: Milad Mohammadi
Milad Mohammadi.summary: Milad Mohammadi Keshmarzi, known as Milad Mohammadi (Persian: ميلاد محمدی کشمرزی; born 29 September 1993) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays for Persian Gulf Pro League club Persepolis and the Iran national team.
Milad Mohammadi.note: For Mohammadi, the foundation is recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. Look first at how he turns early and closes the runner before the box. Also watch how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Milad Mohammadi.noteZh: 最能体现Milad Mohammadi特点的是防线暴露后的回追速度。这一点直接体现在他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。除此之外，他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Mohammad Ghorbani.name: Mohammad Ghorbani
Mohammad Ghorbani.summary: Mohammad Ghorbani is an IR Iran defensive midfielder from Al-Wahda FC who gives the national team central coverage, ball winning, and midfield size.
Mohammad Ghorbani.note: Watch Ghorbani for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. The clearest example is how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Also notice how Ghorbani holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Mohammad Ghorbani.noteZh: 选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢构成Mohammad Ghorbani踢法的核心。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。除此之外，值得留意他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Payam Niazmand.name: Payam Niazmand
Payam Niazmand.summary: Payam Niazmand (Persian: پیام نیازمند; born 6 April 1995) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Iranian club Persepolis and the Iran national team.
Payam Niazmand.note: The key to Niazmand is command of the crowded space around goal. He attacks the cross at the highest point he can control before traffic closes. In another phase, Niazmand keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements.
Payam Niazmand.noteZh: 最能体现Payam Niazmand特点的是掌控门前拥挤空间的能力。这一点直接体现在他会在人群合拢前迎向传中，并在最高可控点处理来球。除此之外，他也会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。

Roozbeh Cheshmi.name: Roozbeh Cheshmi
Roozbeh Cheshmi.summary: Roozbeh Cheshmi (born 24 July 1993) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder or a centre-back for Esteghlal FC in the Persian Gulf League League and the Iran national team.
Roozbeh Cheshmi.note: Cheshmi stands out for reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. Also look at how Cheshmi changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Roozbeh Cheshmi.noteZh: Roozbeh Cheshmi的优势在于争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。最直接的表现是他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。另一个值得观察的细节是他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。

Saeid Ezatolahi.name: Saeid Ezatolahi
Saeid Ezatolahi.summary: Saeid Ezatolahi Afagh (Persian: سعید عزت‌اللهی آفاق; born 1 October 1996) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for club Shabab Al Ahli in UAE Pro League and the Iran national team.
Saeid Ezatolahi.note: What separates Ezatolahi is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. Ezatolahi uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. Also note how he moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Saeid Ezatolahi.noteZh: Saeid Ezatolahi的比赛建立在压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定之上。首先看他如何在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。另一个方面是他会迎向落下的球，在对手站稳前参与争抢。

Saleh Hardani.name: Saleh Hardani
Saleh Hardani.summary: Saleh Hardani Kherad (Persian: صالح حردانی; born 26 December 1998), also known as Saadat Hardani, is an Iranian footballer who plays as a right-back for the Persian Gulf Pro League club Esteghlal and the Iran national team.
Saleh Hardani.note: Hardani's signature is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Watch how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. At another point in the move, he gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Saleh Hardani.noteZh: Saleh Hardani的优势在于从后场加入进攻的启动时机。最直接的表现是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个值得观察的细节是他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Shahriyar Moghanloo.name: Shahriyar Moghanloo
Shahriyar Moghanloo.summary: Shahriyar Moghanlou (Persian: شهريار مغانلو; born 21 December 1994) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a centre-forward for UAE Pro League club Kalba and the Iran national team.
Shahriyar Moghanloo.note: Moghanlou's signature is reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. Watch how he starts outside his marker and attacks the dropping ball. At another point in the move, he pins a defender and creates room for the next runner.
Shahriyar Moghanloo.noteZh: 争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹是理解Shahriyar Moghanlou踢法的关键。先看他如何从盯防者外侧启动，主动攻击落点。到了另一个比赛环节，他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。

Shoja Khalilzadeh.name: Shoja Khalilzadeh
Shoja Khalilzadeh.summary: Shojae Khalilzadeh (Persian: شجاع خلیل‌زاده; born 14 May 1989) is an Iranian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Persian Gulf Pro League club Tractor and Iran national team. He is known for his pace, artistic tackles and positional sense.
Shoja Khalilzadeh.note: The key to Khalilzadeh is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. One more thing to notice is how Khalilzadeh keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Shoja Khalilzadeh.noteZh: 先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢是理解Shojae Khalilzadeh踢法的关键。先看他如何守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。到了另一个比赛环节，他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Alex Paulsen.name: Alex Paulsen
Alex Paulsen.summary: Alexander Noah Paulsen (born 4 July 2002) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for I liga club Lechia Gdańsk, on loan from Bournemouth, and the New Zealand national team.
Alex Paulsen.note: The key to Paulsen is keeping his body shape compact for reflex saves at close range. He keeps his hands and feet connected so the reflex block stays controlled. Elsewhere in the game, Paulsen leaves his line early when a through ball escapes the back line.
Alex Paulsen.noteZh: Alex Paulsen的比赛建立在近距离反应扑救时保持紧凑身体姿态之上。首先看他如何让手脚保持联动，使本能挡球也能控制方向。另一个方面是他会在直塞球越过后防时及时出击。

Alex Rufer.name: Alex Rufer
Alex Rufer.summary: Alex Arthur Rufer (/ˈɹuːfə(ɹ)/; born 12 June 1996) is a New Zealand professional footballer who captains and plays as a defensive midfielder for Wellington Phoenix in the A-League. Born in Switzerland, he represents the New Zealand national team.
Alex Rufer.note: The key to Rufer is reacting first when a duel leaves the ball free. He positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. A separate part of his game is how Rufer holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Alex Rufer.noteZh: 看Alex Rufer的作用，关键是对抗后球权松动时的第一反应。他会在第一次争抢还没结束时，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Ben Old.name: Ben Old
Ben Old.summary: Benjamin Craig Old (born 13 August 2002) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Ligue 2 club Saint-Étienne and the New Zealand national team.
Ben Old.note: For Old, the foundation is carrying momentum through open midfield. Look first at how he pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. Separately, look at how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Ben Old.noteZh: 观察Ben Old时，可以先看带球穿过开放中场的推进力。他会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。另一个比赛细节是他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Ben Waine.name: Ben Waine
Ben Waine.summary: Benjamin Peter Waine (born 11 June 2001) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL League Two club Port Vale and the New Zealand national team.
Ben Waine.note: Waine stands out for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Also look at how Waine arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Ben Waine.noteZh: Ben Waine最鲜明的特点是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。一个直接线索是他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。另一个独立细节是他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Callan Elliot.name: Callan Elliot
Callan Elliot.summary: Callan Rennie Elliot (born 7 July 1999) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a right back for A-League club Auckland FC and the New Zealand national team.
Callan Elliot.note: Elliot's signature is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Watch how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Another detail is how he turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Callan Elliot.noteZh: Callan Elliot最鲜明的特点是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。一个直接线索是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个独立细节是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Callum McCowatt.name: Callum McCowatt
Callum McCowatt.summary: Callum William McCowatt (born 30 April 1999) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Danish Superliga club Silkeborg and the New Zealand national team.
Callum McCowatt.note: Watch McCowatt for waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. The clearest example is how he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. Also notice how McCowatt moves toward the ball as teammates close the nearby options.
Callum McCowatt.noteZh: 最能体现Callum McCowatt特点的是等防守者注意力转移后再启动。这一点直接体现在他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。除此之外，他也会队友封住附近选项时向球靠近施压。

Francis De Vries.name: Francis De Vries

Joe Bell.noteZh: 用传球的力度和角度移动防线构成Joe Bell踢法的核心。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。除此之外，值得留意他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Lachlan Bayliss.name: Lachlan Bayliss

Lachlan Bayliss.note: Bayliss stands out for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. In a separate phase, Bayliss moves the ball to the next available teammate without holding it.

Thibaut Courtois.summary: Thibaut Nicolas Marc Courtois (French pronunciation: [tibo kuʁtwa]; Dutch pronunciation: [ˈtiboː kurˈtʋaː]; born 11 May 1992) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for La Liga club Real Madrid and the Belgium national team.
Thibaut Courtois.note: The key to Courtois is protecting the centre before the shooter reveals the finish. He sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot. Elsewhere in the game, Courtois leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Thibaut Courtois.noteZh: 最能体现Thibaut Courtois特点的是射手暴露射门方向前先守住球门中央。这一点直接体现在他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。除此之外，他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Thomas Meunier.name: Thomas Meunier
Thomas Meunier.summary: Thomas André A. Meunier (French pronunciation: [tɔma mønje]; born 12 September 1991) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Ligue 1 club Lille and the Belgium national team.
Thomas Meunier.note: For Meunier, the foundation is arriving at the far side after defenders have narrowed toward the ball. Look first at how he holds the far-post lane, then attacks it as the cross leaves the passer. Separately, look at how he meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Thomas Meunier.noteZh: 观察Thomas Meunier时，可以先看等防守者向球侧收缩后再到达后点。他会先留在后点线路，等传中离脚后再启动攻击落点。另一个比赛细节是他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Timothy Castagne.name: Timothy Castagne
Timothy Castagne.summary: Timothy Castagne (French pronunciation: [timɔti kastaɲ]; born 5 December 1995) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a full back for Premier League club Fulham and the Belgium national team.
Timothy Castagne.note: Watch Castagne for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. The clearest example is how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. In a different phase, Castagne changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Timothy Castagne.noteZh: Timothy Castagne最鲜明的特点是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。一个直接线索是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个独立细节是他会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。

Youri Tielemans.name: Youri Tielemans
Youri Tielemans.summary: Youri Marion A. Tielemans (born 7 May 1997) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Aston Villa and captains the Belgium national team.
Youri Tielemans.note: The key to Tielemans is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. In another phase, Tielemans uses a clean first touch to open a shooting lane from distance.
Youri Tielemans.noteZh: 用传球的力度和角度移动防线是理解Youri Tielemans踢法的关键。先看他如何穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。到了另一个比赛环节，他会用干净的第一脚触球打开远射线路。

Zeno Debast.name: Zeno Debast
Zeno Debast.summary: Zeno Koen Debast (born 24 October 2003) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays for Primeira Liga club Sporting CP and the Belgium national team. Primarily a centre-back, he can also be deployed as a defensive midfielder.
Zeno Debast.note: Debast's signature is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Watch how he takes the first available forward lane before it closes. Away from that moment, he adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple.
Zeno Debast.noteZh: Zeno Debast的优势在于用传球的力度和角度移动防线。最直接的表现是他会在向前线路关闭前及时送出传球。另一个值得观察的细节是他会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。

Alberto Quintero.name: Alberto Quintero
Alberto Quintero.summary: Alberto Abdiel Quintero Medina (born 18 December 1987) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays for C.D. Plaza Amador and the Panama national team as a winger.
Alberto Quintero.note: Watch Quintero for changing direction without losing control of the ball. The clearest example is how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. Elsewhere, Quintero slows the play to restore control and takes the risk once the opening is clear.
Alberto Quintero.noteZh: Alberto Quintero的优势在于变向时仍把球控制在脚下。最直接的表现是他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。另一个值得观察的细节是他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Andres Andrade.name: Andres Andrade
Andres Andrade.summary: Andrés Alberto Andrade Cedeño (born 16 October 1998) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Austrian Football Bundesliga club LASK and the Panama national team.
Andres Andrade.note: For Andrade, the foundation is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Look first at how he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. Separately, look at how he holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Andres Andrade.noteZh: 看Andrés Andrade的作用，关键是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Anibal Godoy.name: Anibal Godoy
Anibal Godoy.summary: Aníbal Casis Godoy Lemus (Spanish: [aˈniβal ɣoˈðoj]; born 10 February 1990) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Major League Soccer club San Diego FC and captains the Panama national team.
Anibal Godoy.note: Godoy's signature is organizing the nearby unit before the next phase begins. Watch how he uses short cues to keep nearby passing and pressing options connected. Separately, he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Anibal Godoy.noteZh: 看Aníbal Godoy的作用，关键是下一阶段开始前组织身边队友。他会用简短提醒让附近的传球与逼抢选择保持连接。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Azarias Londono.name: Azarias Londono
Azarias Londono.summary: Azarias Emmanuel Londoño González (born 21 June 2001) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as forward for Universidad Católica, on loan from Alianza, and the Panama national team.
Azarias Londono.note: For Londoño, the foundation is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. Look first at how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Beyond that, watch how he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Azarias Londono.noteZh: 看Azarias Londoño的作用，关键是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Carlos Harvey.name: Carlos Harvey
Carlos Harvey.summary: Carlos Miguel Harvey Cesneros (born 3 February 2000) is a Panamaian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Major League Soccer club Minnesota United FC and the Panama national team.
Carlos Harvey.note: Watch Harvey for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. The clearest example is how he holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. Also watch how Harvey moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Carlos Harvey.noteZh: Carlos Harvey的比赛建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢之上。首先看他如何守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个方面是他会迎向落下的球，在对手站稳前参与争抢。

Cecilio Waterman.name: Cecilio Waterman
Cecilio Waterman.summary: Cecilio Alfonso Waterman Ruiz (born 13 April 1991) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Chilean club Universidad de Concepción and the Panama national team.
Cecilio Waterman.note: What separates Waterman is reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. Waterman starts outside his marker and attacks the dropping ball. Also note how he pins a defender and creates room for the next runner.
Cecilio Waterman.noteZh: Cecilio Waterman最鲜明的特点是争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。一个直接线索是他会从盯防者外侧启动，主动攻击落点。另一个独立细节是他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。

Cesar Blackman.name: Cesar Blackman
Cesar Blackman.summary: César Rodolfo Blackman Camarena (born 2 April 1998) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Slovak First Football League club Slovan Bratislava and the Panama national team.
Cesar Blackman.note: Blackman stands out for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Another aspect is how Blackman turns early and closes the runner before the box.
Cesar Blackman.noteZh: 最能体现César Blackman特点的是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。这一点直接体现在他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。除此之外，他也会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。

Cesar Samudio.name: Cesar Samudio
Cesar Samudio.summary: César Jair Samudio Murillo (born 23 February 1994) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Honduran side Marathón and the Panama national team.
Cesar Samudio.note: The key to Samudio is sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. In another phase, Samudio leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Cesar Samudio.noteZh: 最能体现César Samudio特点的是提前站位后的快速反应。这一点直接体现在他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。除此之外，他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Cesar Yanis.name: Cesar Yanis
Cesar Yanis.summary: César Augusto Yanis Velasco (born 28 January 1996) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as left winger for Chilean club Cobresal, on loan from Costa Rican club San Carlos, and the Panama national team.
Cesar Yanis.note: Yanis's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Watch how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He also pulls the ball back from near the end line toward a supporting runner.
Cesar Yanis.noteZh: 变向时仍把球控制在脚下构成César Yanis踢法的核心。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。除此之外，值得留意他会接近底线后把球回传给后排接应的队友。

Cristian Martinez.name: Cristian Martinez

Edgar Yoel Barcenas.name: Edgar Yoel Barcenas
Edgar Yoel Barcenas.summary: Édgar Yoel Bárcenas Herrera (born 23 October 1993) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a winger for the Panama national team.

Edgar Yoel Barcenas.noteZh: Yoel Bárcenas最鲜明的特点是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。一个直接线索是他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。另一个独立细节是他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Edgardo Farina.name: Edgardo Farina

Edgardo Farina.noteZh: Edgardo Fariña的优势在于第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。最直接的表现是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。另一个值得观察的细节是他会迎向落下的球，在进攻者站稳前参与争抢。

Eric Davis.name: Eric Davis
Eric Davis.summary: Eric Javier Davis Grajales (born 31 March 1991) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Plaza Amador and the Panama national team.
Eric Davis.note: Davis stands out for calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He slows the play to restore control and takes the risk once the opening is clear. In a separate phase, Davis serves corners and free kicks into the attacking area.
Eric Davis.noteZh: Eric Davis最鲜明的特点是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。一个直接线索是他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。另一个独立细节是他会把角球和任意球送入进攻区域。

Fidel Escobar.name: Fidel Escobar

Fidel Escobar.note: For Escobar, the foundation is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. Look first at how he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. A separate point is how he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.

Jiovany Ramos.name: Jiovany Ramos

Jiovany Ramos.noteZh: 观察Jiovany Ramos时，可以先看先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。另一个比赛细节是他会迎向来球，在前锋站稳前头球解围。

Jorge Gutierrez.name: Jorge Gutierrez
Jorge Gutierrez.summary: Jorge Abdiel Gutiérrez Cornejo (born 1 September 1998) is a Panamanian football player who plays as left-back for Deportivo La Guaira, and the Panama national team.

Jose Cordoba.name: Jose Cordoba
Jose Cordoba.summary: José Ángel Córdoba Chambers (born 3 June 2001) is a Panamanian professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Norwich City and the Panama national team.

Jose Fajardo.name: Jose Fajardo

Tomas Rodriguez.name: Tomas Rodriguez

Anthony Gordon.name: Anthony Gordon

Bukayo Saka.name: Bukayo Saka

Dan Burn.name: Dan Burn

Dean Henderson.name: Dean Henderson

Eberechi Eze.name: Eberechi Eze
Eberechi Eze.summary: Eberechi Oluchi "Ebere" Eze ( ə-BAIR-ə-tchee EZ-ə ; born 29 June 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Premier League club Arsenal and the England national team.
Eberechi Eze.note: The key to Eze is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. There is another side to his game: he shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Eberechi Eze.noteZh: 变向时仍把球控制在脚下是理解Eberechi Eze踢法的关键。先看他如何在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。到了另一个比赛环节，他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Elliot Anderson.name: Elliot Anderson
Elliot Anderson.summary: Elliot Junior Anderson (born 6 November 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Nottingham Forest and the England national team.
Elliot Anderson.note: For Anderson, the foundation is carrying momentum through open midfield. Look first at how he pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. Separately, look at how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Elliot Anderson.noteZh: 看Elliot Anderson的作用，关键是带球穿过开放中场的推进力。他会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Ezri Konsa.name: Ezri Konsa
Ezri Konsa.summary: Ezri Ngoyo Konsa (born 23 October 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or right-back for Premier League club Aston Villa and the England national team.
Ezri Konsa.note: Konsa's signature is recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. Watch how he turns early and protects the route toward goal. For a wider read, also watch whether he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Ezri Konsa.noteZh: 最能体现Ezri Konsa特点的是第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。这一点直接体现在他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。接着可以问，他是否会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Ivan Toney.name: Ivan Toney
Ivan Toney.summary: Ivan Benjamin Elijah Toney (born 16 March 1996) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for Saudi Pro League club Al-Ahli and the England national team.
Ivan Toney.note: What separates Toney is giving centre-backs a physical problem they cannot ignore. Toney pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. Away from that action, he absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward.
Ivan Toney.noteZh: 让中后卫无法忽视的身体支点作用构成Ivan Toney踢法的核心。他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。除此之外，值得留意他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。

James Trafford.name: James Trafford
James Trafford.summary: James Harrington Trafford (born 10 October 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Manchester City and the England national team.
James Trafford.note: The key to Trafford is protecting the centre before the shooter reveals the finish. He sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot. Elsewhere in the game, Trafford restarts play toward an available teammate.
James Trafford.noteZh: James Trafford的优势在于射手暴露射门方向前先守住球门中央。最直接的表现是他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。另一个值得观察的细节是他会把球重新交给可以接应的队友。

Jarell Quansah.name: Jarell Quansah
Jarell Quansah.summary: Jarell Amorin Quansah (born 29 January 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen and the England national team.
Jarell Quansah.note: Watch Quansah for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. The clearest example is how he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. Also notice how Quansah turns early and closes the runner before the box.
Jarell Quansah.noteZh: 用传球的力度和角度移动防线是理解Jarell Quansah踢法的关键。先看他如何穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。到了另一个比赛环节，他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。

John Stones.name: John Stones
John Stones.summary: John Stones (born 28 May 1994) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or defensive midfielder for Premier League club Manchester City and the England national team.
John Stones.note: Stones's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Watch how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. For a wider read, also watch whether he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
John Stones.noteZh: 最能体现John Stones特点的是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。这一点直接体现在他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。接着可以问，他是否会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Jordan Henderson.name: Jordan Henderson
Jordan Henderson.summary: Jordan Brian Henderson (born 17 June 1990) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Brentford and the England national team. He is known for his leadership, versatility, and physicality.
Jordan Henderson.note: Henderson stands out for organizing the nearby unit before the next phase begins. He uses short cues to keep nearby passing and pressing options connected. Henderson also angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Jordan Henderson.noteZh: 最能体现Henderson特点的是下一阶段开始前组织身边队友。这一点直接体现在他会用简短提醒让附近的传球与逼抢选择保持连接。除此之外，他也会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Jordan Pickford.name: Jordan Pickford
Jordan Pickford.summary: Jordan Lee Pickford (né Logan; born 7 March 1994) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Premier League club Everton and the England national team.
Jordan Pickford.note: For Pickford, the foundation is turning a save into the first pass of an attack. Look first at how he chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. Also watch how he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Jordan Pickford.noteZh: Pickford的比赛建立在把一次扑救变成进攻第一传之上。首先看他如何在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。另一个方面是他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Kobbie Mainoo.name: Kobbie Mainoo
Kobbie Mainoo.summary: Kobbie Boateng Mainoo (; born 19 April 2005) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Premier League club Manchester United and the England national team. He is known for his dribbling and composure.
Kobbie Mainoo.note: Mainoo stands out for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. Mainoo also pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it.
Kobbie Mainoo.noteZh: Kobbie Mainoo的优势在于压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。最直接的表现是他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。另一个值得观察的细节是他会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。

Marc Guehi.name: Marc Guehi
Marc Guehi.summary: Addji Keaninkin Marc-Israel Guéhi ( GAY-ee; born 13 July 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Premier League club Manchester City and the England national team.
Marc Guehi.note: Watch Guéhi for recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. The clearest example is how he turns early and protects the route toward goal. Also notice how Guéhi adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple.
Marc Guehi.noteZh: 最能体现Marc Guéhi特点的是第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。这一点直接体现在他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。除此之外，他也会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。

Morgan Rogers.name: Morgan Rogers

Nico Oreilly.noteZh: 理解Nico O'Reilly，要先看等防守者注意力转移后再启动。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会用左脚送出眼前可行的传球。

Reece James.name: Reece James

Dominik Kotarski.name: Dominik Kotarski
Dominik Kotarski.summary: Dominik Kotarski (Croatian pronunciation: [dôminik kôtarskiː, domǐ-]; born 10 February 2000) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Danish Superliga club Copenhagen and the Croatia national team.

Dominik Livakovic.name: Dominik Livakovic
Dominik Livakovic.summary: Dominik Livaković (Croatian pronunciation: [dôminik liʋǎːkoʋitɕ, domǐ-]; born 9 January 1995) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Croatian Football League club Dinamo Zagreb, on loan from Süper Lig club Fenerbahçe, and the...
Dominik Livakovic.note: The key to Livaković is the patience to read a penalty taker's last movement. He waits for the strike before committing. A separate part of his game is how Livaković keeps his decisions calm when a sudden save is required.
