Abdul Fatawu.name: Abdul Fatawu
Abdul Fatawu.summary: Abdul Fatawu Issahaku (born 8 March 2004), commonly known as Abdul Fatawu, is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League One club Leicester City and the Ghana national team.
Abdul Fatawu.note: Fatawu stands out for explosive speed once open grass appears. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. A different detail is how Fatawu pulls the ball back from near the end line toward a supporting runner.
Abdul Fatawu.noteZh: Abdul Fatawu的比赛建立在看到空当后的爆发速度之上。首先看他如何等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。另一个方面是他会接近底线后把球回传给后排接应的队友。

Abdul Mumin.name: Abdul Mumin
Abdul Mumin.summary: Khalid Abdul Mumin Suleman (born 6 June 1998), commonly known as Abdul Mumin, is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Rayo Vallecano and the Ghana national team.
Abdul Mumin.note: What separates Mumin is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Mumin holds the route into the box until support arrives. A separate detail appears when he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Abdul Mumin.noteZh: 理解Abdul Mumin，要先看先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Ali Azaizeh.name: Ali Azaizeh
Ali Azaizeh.summary: Ali Ahmad Ali Azaizeh (Arabic: علي العزايزة; born 13 April 2004) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Saudi Pro League club Al-Shabab, on loan from Kuwait Premier League club Kazma.
Ali Azaizeh.note: Watch Azaizeh for making purposeful movement away from the ball. The clearest example is how he changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. Elsewhere, Azaizeh looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Ali Azaizeh.noteZh: 最能体现Ali Azaizeh特点的是有目的地进行无球移动。这一点直接体现在他会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。除此之外，他也会在传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Alidu Seidu.name: Alidu Seidu
Alidu Seidu.summary: Alidu Seidu (born 4 June 2000) is a Ghanaian-French professional footballer who plays as a defender for French Ligue 1 club Rennes and the Ghana national team.
Alidu Seidu.note: Watch Seidu for recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. The clearest example is how he turns early and closes the runner before the box. Also notice how Seidu waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Alidu Seidu.noteZh: Alidu Seidu最鲜明的特点是防线暴露后的回追速度。一个直接线索是他会提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。另一个独立细节是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。

Amer Jamous.name: Amer Jamous
Amer Jamous.summary: Amer Rasem Adel Jamous (Arabic: عَامِر رَاسِم عَادِل جَامُوس; born 3 July 2002) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Iraq Stars League club Al-Zawraa, on loan from Al-Wehdat, as well as the Jordan national team.
Amer Jamous.note: Watch Jamous for making purposeful movement away from the ball. The clearest example is how he changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. Elsewhere, Jamous turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Amer Jamous.noteZh: 最能体现Amer Jamous特点的是有目的地进行无球移动。这一点直接体现在他会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。除此之外，他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Anas Badawi.name: Anas Badawi
Anas Badawi.summary: Anas Saeed Badawi (Arabic: أنس بدوي; born 13 September 1997) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Jordanian Pro League club Al-Faisaly and the Jordan national team.
Anas Badawi.note: Badawi stands out for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. In a separate phase, Badawi gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Anas Badawi.noteZh: 看Anas Badawi的作用，关键是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Augustine Boakye.name: Augustine Boakye
Augustine Boakye.summary: Augustine Boakye (born 3 November 2000) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 2 club Saint-Étienne and the Ghana national team.
Augustine Boakye.note: Boakye's signature is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. Watch how he draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. At another point in the move, he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Augustine Boakye.noteZh: 最能体现Augustine Boakye特点的是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。这一点直接体现在他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。除此之外，他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Baba Rahman.name: Baba Rahman
Baba Rahman.summary: Abdul Rahman Baba (born 2 July 1994), also known as Baba Rahman, is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Super League Greece club PAOK and the Ghana national team.
Baba Rahman.note: Baba stands out for recovering position without panicking after the first line is broken. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. A different detail is how Baba sends the ball into the attacking area from a wide position.
Baba Rahman.noteZh: 看Abdul Rahman Baba的作用，关键是第一道防线被突破后仍能冷静回位。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会在边路位置把球送入进攻区域。

Benjamin Asare.name: Benjamin Asare
Benjamin Asare.summary: Benjamin Asare (born 13 July 1992) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Accra Hearts of Oak in the Ghana Premier League and the Ghana national team.
Benjamin Asare.note: The key to Asare is command of the crowded space around goal. He leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders. In another phase, Asare sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Benjamin Asare.noteZh: 看Benjamin Asare的作用，关键是掌控门前拥挤空间的能力。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Brandon Thomas-Asante.name: Brandon Thomas-Asante
Brandon Thomas-Asante.summary: Solomon Brandon Michael Clarke Thomas-Asante (born 29 December 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre forward for Premier League club Coventry City. Born in England, he plays for the Ghana national team.
Brandon Thomas-Asante.note: For Thomas-Asante, the foundation is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. Look first at how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Beyond the first action, he arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Brandon Thomas-Asante.noteZh: 看Brandon Thomas-Asante的作用，关键是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Christopher Bonsu Baah.name: Christopher Bonsu Baah
Christopher Bonsu Baah.summary: Christopher Bonsu Baah (born 14 December 2004) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Saudi Pro League side Al-Qadsiah and the Ghana national team.
Christopher Bonsu Baah.note: The key to Baah is explosive speed once open grass appears. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. There is another side to his game: he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Christopher Bonsu Baah.noteZh: 理解Christopher Bonsu Baah，要先看看到空当后的爆发速度。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Derrick Luckassen.name: Derrick Luckassen
Derrick Luckassen.summary: Derrick Luckassen (born 3 July 1995) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Cypriot club Pafos. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Ghana national team.
Derrick Luckassen.note: Luckassen stands out for calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He slows the play to restore control and takes the risk once the opening is clear. In a separate phase, Luckassen moves toward the dropping ball and contests it before the attacker can settle.
Derrick Luckassen.noteZh: 看Derrick Luckassen的作用，关键是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会迎向落下的球，在对手站稳前参与争抢。

Ehsan Haddad.name: Ehsan Haddad
Ehsan Haddad.summary: Ehsan Manial Farhan Haddad (Arabic: إِحْسَان منيل فَرْحَان حَدَّاد; born 5 February 1994) is a Jordanian footballer who plays for the Jordanian club Al-Hussein and the Jordan national team.
Ehsan Haddad.note: What separates Haddad is closing the crossing angle without losing the runner. Haddad gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in. In another phase of play, he slows the play to restore control and takes the risk once the opening is clear.
Ehsan Haddad.noteZh: 看Ehsan Haddad的作用，关键是封住传中角度时仍不丢掉跑动者。他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Elisha Owusu.name: Elisha Owusu
Elisha Owusu.summary: Elisha Owusu (born 7 November 1997) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Auxerre. Born in France, he plays for the Ghana national team.
Elisha Owusu.note: Owusu's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Watch how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. At another point in the move, he holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Elisha Owusu.noteZh: 看Elisha Owusu的作用，关键是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Ernest Nuamah.name: Ernest Nuamah
Ernest Nuamah.summary: Ernest Nuamah Appiah (born 1 November 2003) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Ligue 1 club Lyon and the Ghana national team.
Ernest Nuamah.note: For Nuamah, the foundation is explosive speed once open grass appears. Look first at how he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. A separate point is how he shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Ernest Nuamah.noteZh: 理解Ernest Nuamah，要先看看到空当后的爆发速度。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Gideon Mensah.name: Gideon Mensah
Gideon Mensah.summary: Gideon Mensah (born 18 July 1998) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Ligue 1 club Auxerre and the Ghana national team.
Gideon Mensah.note: Watch Mensah for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. The clearest example is how he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. A separate clue is how Mensah gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Gideon Mensah.noteZh: 理解Gideon Mensah，要先看从后场加入进攻的启动时机。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Husam Abu Dahab.name: Husam Abu Dahab
Husam Abu Dahab.summary: Husam Ali Mohammad Abu Dahab (Arabic: حُسَام عَلِيّ مُحَمَّد أَبُو ذَهَب, born 13 May 2000) is a Jordanian footballer who is a center-back for Jordanian Pro League club Al-Faisaly, as well as the Jordan national team.
Husam Abu Dahab.note: Dahab's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. Watch how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. At another point in the move, he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Husam Abu Dahab.noteZh: 最能体现Husam Abu Dahab特点的是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。这一点直接体现在他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。除此之外，他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Ibrahim Sadeh.name: Ibrahim Sadeh
Ibrahim Sadeh.summary: Ibrahim Mohammad Sami Sadeh (Arabic: إبراهيم سعادة; born 27 April 2000) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Iraqi Stars League side Al-Karma and the Jordan national team.
Ibrahim Sadeh.note: For Sadeh, the foundation is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Look first at how he plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. Beyond that, watch how he positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over.
Ibrahim Sadeh.noteZh: 看Ibrahim Sadeh的作用，关键是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会在第一次争抢还没结束时，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。

Jerome Opoku.name: Jerome Opoku
Jerome Opoku.summary: Jerome Osei Opoku (born 14 October 1998) is a professional footballer. He plays as a centre-back for Süper Lig club İstanbul Başakşehir.
Jerome Opoku.note: What separates Opoku is making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. Opoku protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. At another point, he plays the available pass with his left foot.
Jerome Opoku.noteZh: 理解Jerome Opoku，要先看对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会用左脚送出眼前可行的传球。

Jonas Adjetey.name: Jonas Adjetey
Jonas Adjetey.summary: Jonas Adjei Adjetey (born 13 December 2003) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays for German 2. Bundesliga side VfL Wolfsburg and the Ghana national team. He plays mainly in the position of centre-back, but can also play as full-back on either side.
Jonas Adjetey.note: For Adjetey, the foundation is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Look first at how he waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. Beyond that, watch how he absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward.
Jonas Adjetey.noteZh: 选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢构成Jonas Adjetey踢法的核心。他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。除此之外，值得留意他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。

Joseph Anang.name: Joseph Anang
Joseph Anang.summary: Joseph Tetteh Anang (born 8 June 2000) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for League of Ireland Premier Division club St Patrick's Athletic and the Ghana national team.
Joseph Anang.note: Anang stands out for keeping his body shape compact for reflex saves at close range. He keeps his hands and feet connected so the reflex block stays controlled. In a separate phase, Anang chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Joseph Anang.noteZh: Joseph Anang的优势在于近距离反应扑救时保持紧凑身体姿态。最直接的表现是他会让手脚保持联动，使本能挡球也能控制方向。另一个值得观察的细节是他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Kamaldeen Sulemana.name: Kamaldeen Sulemana
Kamaldeen Sulemana.summary: Kamaldeen Sulemana (born 15 February 2002), also known simply as Kamaldeen, is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a left winger or a forward for Serie A club Atalanta and the Ghana national team.
Kamaldeen Sulemana.note: Watch Sulemana for changing direction without losing control of the ball. The clearest example is how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. Elsewhere, Sulemana changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Kamaldeen Sulemana.noteZh: 变向时仍把球控制在脚下构成Kamaldeen Sulemana踢法的核心。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。除此之外，值得留意他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Kojo Peprah Oppong.name: Kojo Peprah Oppong
Kojo Peprah Oppong.summary: Kojo Peprah Oppong (born 4 June 2004) is a French-Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Ligue 1 club Nice and the Ghana national team.
Kojo Peprah Oppong.note: What separates Oppong is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. Oppong plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. Also note how he turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Kojo Peprah Oppong.noteZh: 观察Kojo Peprah Oppong时，可以先看用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。另一个比赛细节是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Kwasi Sibo.name: Kwasi Sibo
Kwasi Sibo.summary: Kwasi Sibo (born 24 June 1998) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Segunda División club Real Oviedo and the Ghana national team.
Kwasi Sibo.note: Sibo's signature is reacting first when a duel leaves the ball free. Watch how he positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. He also pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it.
Kwasi Sibo.noteZh: 对抗后球权松动时的第一反应是理解Kwasi Sibo踢法的关键。先看他如何在第一次争抢还没结束时，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。到了另一个比赛环节，他会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。

Lawrence Ati-Zigi.name: Lawrence Ati-Zigi
Lawrence Ati-Zigi.summary: Lawrence Ati-Zigi (born 29 November 1996) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Swiss Super League club St. Gallen and the Ghana national team. Ati-Zigi has represented Ghana at under-17 and under-20 levels.
Lawrence Ati-Zigi.note: The key to Ati-Zigi is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. There is another side to his game: he sets his angle early and holds the centre until the ball leaves the foot.
Lawrence Ati-Zigi.noteZh: 危险出现前组织好队友是理解Lawrence Ati-Zigi踢法的关键。先看他如何用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。到了另一个比赛环节，他会提前调整封堵角度，在球离脚前始终封住中央线路。

Mahmoud Al-Mardi.name: Mahmoud Al-Mardi
Mahmoud Al-Mardi.summary: Mahmoud Nayef Mardi Al-Hwaitat (Arabic: مَحْمُود نَايِف مَرْضِيّ الحويطات; born 6 October 1993) is a Jordanian footballer who plays as a winger for the Jordanian club Al-Hussein and the Jordan national team.
Mahmoud Al-Mardi.note: The key to Mardi is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. In another phase, Mardi moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Mahmoud Al-Mardi.noteZh: 理解Mahmoud Mardi，要先看防线重组前制造干净射门。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Marvin Senaya.name: Marvin Senaya
Marvin Senaya.summary: Marvin Senaya (born 28 January 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Ligue 1 club Auxerre. Born in France, he plays for the Ghana national team.

Mohammad Abu Alnadi.name: Mohammad Abu Alnadi
Mohammad Abu Alnadi.summary: Mohammad Abu Alnadi is a Jordanian centre-back for Selangor and the Jordan national team.

Mohammad Abu Ghoush.summary: Mohammad Ahmed Mohammad Taha (Arabic: محمد أحمد محمد طه; born 13 July 2005), also known as Mohammad Abu Ghoush (Arabic: محمد أبو غوش), is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a left back for Jordanian Pro League club Al-Hussein, on loan from Shabab...
Mohammad Abu Ghoush.note: Taha stands out for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. In a separate phase, Taha gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in.
Mohammad Abu Ghoush.noteZh: 最能体现Mohammad Taha特点的是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。这一点直接体现在他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。除此之外，他也会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。

Mohammad Abu Hasheesh.name: Mohammad Abu Hasheesh
Mohammad Abu Hasheesh.summary: Mohammad Ali Hasan Abu Hashish (Arabic: مُحَمَّد عَلِيّ حَسَن أَبُو حَشِيش; born 9 May 1995) is a professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Iraq Stars League side Al-Karma. Born in Iraq, he represents the Jordan national team.
Mohammad Abu Hasheesh.note: What separates Hashish is closing the crossing angle without losing the runner. Hashish gets close enough to block the delivery without diving in. Away from that action, he waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Mohammad Abu Hasheesh.noteZh: 封住传中角度时仍不丢掉跑动者构成Mohammad Abu Hashish踢法的核心。他会靠近到能封堵传中，但不贸然出脚。除此之外，值得留意他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Mohammad Abu Zraiq.name: Mohammad Abu Zraiq
Mohammad Abu Zraiq.summary: Mohammad Faisal Yousef Abu Zrayq (Arabic: محمد فيصل يوسف أبو زريق, born 30 December 1997), popularly known as Sharara (Arabic: شرارة), is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Botola Pro club Raja CA and the Jordan national team.
Mohammad Abu Zraiq.note: Zraiq's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. Watch how he draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. Away from that moment, he changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Mohammad Abu Zraiq.noteZh: 变向时仍把球控制在脚下是理解Mohammad Abu Zraiq踢法的关键。先看他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。到了另一个比赛环节，他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Mohammad Al-Daoud.name: Mohammad Al-Daoud
Mohammad Al-Daoud.summary: Mohammad Rateb Al-Dawoud (Arabic: مُحَمَّد رَاتِب الدَّاوُود; born 12 April 1992) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Jordanian Pro League club Al-Wehdat and the Jordan national team.
Mohammad Al-Daoud.note: Watch Al-Daoud for reacting first when a duel leaves the ball free. The clearest example is how he positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. A separate clue is how Al-Daoud uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Mohammad Al-Daoud.noteZh: Mohammad Al-Daoud的比赛建立在对抗后球权松动时的第一反应之上。首先看他如何在第一次争抢还没结束时，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。另一个方面是他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Mohannad Abu Taha.name: Mohannad Abu Taha
Mohannad Abu Taha.summary: Mohannad Mahmoud Saleh Abu Taha (Arabic: مُهَنَّد مَحْمُود صَالِح أَبُو طٰهٰ; born 2 February 2003) is a Jordanian footballer who plays as a winger or left-back for Iraq Stars League club Al-Quwa Al-Jawiya, and the Jordan national team.
Mohannad Abu Taha.note: The key to Taha is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. A separate part of his game is how Taha turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Mohannad Abu Taha.noteZh: 理解Mohannad Abu Taha，要先看从后场加入进攻的启动时机。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Nizar Al-Rashdan.name: Nizar Al-Rashdan
Nizar Al-Rashdan.summary: Nizar Mahmoud Ahmed Al-Rashdan (Arabic: نزار الرشدان; born 23 March 1999) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Qatar Stars League club Qatar SC and the Jordan national team.
Nizar Al-Rashdan.note: What separates Al-Rashdan is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. Al-Rashdan waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. A separate detail appears when he holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Nizar Al-Rashdan.noteZh: Nizar Al-Rashdan最鲜明的特点是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。一个直接线索是他会等对手触球稍大后果断上抢。另一个独立细节是他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Nour Bani Attiah.name: Nour Bani Attiah
Nour Bani Attiah.summary: Noureddin Ziad Bani Attiah (Arabic: نُور الدِّين زِيَاد بَنِي عَطِيَّة; born 25 January 1993) is a Jordanian footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Al-Faisaly and the Jordan national team.
Nour Bani Attiah.note: The key to Attiah is command of the crowded space around goal. He attacks the cross at the highest point he can control before traffic closes. One more thing to notice is how Attiah keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Nour Bani Attiah.noteZh: 观察Nour Bani Attiah时，可以先看掌控门前拥挤空间的能力。他会在人群合拢前迎向传中，并在最高可控点处理来球。另一个比赛细节是他会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Odeh Fakhoury.name: Odeh Fakhoury
Odeh Fakhoury.summary: Odeh Burhan Shehadeh Fakhoury (Arabic: عودة برهان شحادة الفاخوري; born 22 November 2005) is a Jordanian footballer who plays as a forward for Egyptian Premier League club Pyramids and the Jordan national team.
Odeh Fakhoury.note: Al-Fakhouri's signature is making purposeful movement away from the ball. Watch how he changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. At another point in the move, he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Odeh Fakhoury.noteZh: 理解Odeh Al-Fakhouri，要先看有目的地进行无球移动。他会提前调整位置，为持球队友提供清晰目标。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Prince Adu.name: Prince Adu
Prince Adu.summary: Prince Kwabena Adu (born 23 September 2003) is a Ghanaian footballer who plays for Viktoria Plzeň and the Ghana national team. He was included in The Guardian's "Next Generation 2020".
Prince Adu.note: Adu's signature is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. Watch how he angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. Away from that moment, he moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Prince Adu.noteZh: 带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑是理解Prince Kwabena Adu踢法的关键。先看他如何在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。到了另一个比赛环节，他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Rajaei Ayed.name: Rajaei Ayed
Rajaei Ayed.summary: Raja'ei Ayed Fadel Hasan (Arabic: رَجَائِيّ عَايِد فَاضِل حَسَن; born 25 July 1993) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Jordanian Pro League club Al-Hussein and the Jordan national team.
Rajaei Ayed.note: For Ayed, the foundation is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. Look first at how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. A separate point is how he holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Rajaei Ayed.noteZh: 压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定构成Raja'ei Ayed踢法的核心。他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。除此之外，值得留意他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Saed Al-Rosan.name: Saed Al-Rosan
Saed Al-Rosan.summary: Saed Ahmad Salameh Al-Rosan (Arabic: سَعْد أَحْمَد سَلَامَة الرُّوسَان; born 1 February 1997) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a center-back for Jordanian Pro League side Al-Hussein and the Jordan national team.
Saed Al-Rosan.note: Watch Al-Rosan for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. The clearest example is how he holds the route into the box until support arrives. A separate clue is how Al-Rosan meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Saed Al-Rosan.noteZh: 看Saed Al-Rosan的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Saleem Obaid.name: Saleem Obaid
Saleem Obaid.summary: Saleem Amer Obaid (Arabic: سَلِيم عَامِر عُبَيْد; born 17 January 1992) is a Jordanian footballer who plays as a left back for Jordanian Pro League side Al-Hussein and the Jordan national team.
Saleem Obaid.note: Obaid stands out for reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He steps toward the flight and heads clear before the forward can set himself. In a separate phase, Obaid uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Saleem Obaid.noteZh: 看Saleem Obaid的作用，关键是争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。他会迎向来球，在前锋站稳前头球解围。换到另一个阶段，还可以看到他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Yazan Al-Arab.name: Yazan Al-Arab
Yazan Al-Arab.summary: Yazan Mousa Mahmoud Abu Al-Arab (Arabic: يَزَن مُوسَى مَحْمُود أَبُو الْعَرَب; born 31 January 1996) is a Jordanian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for K-League side FC Seoul and the Jordan national team.
Yazan Al-Arab.note: For Al-Arab, the foundation is organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. Look first at how he keeps the line connected with constant small instructions. Also watch how he uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Yazan Al-Arab.noteZh: 危险出现前组织好队友是理解Yazan Al-Arab踢法的关键。先看他如何用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。到了另一个比赛环节，他会在第一脚触球时先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Yazeed Abulaila.name: Yazeed Abulaila
Yazeed Abulaila.summary: Yazeed Moein Hasan Abu Laila (Arabic: يَزِيد مُعِين حَسَن أَبُو لَيْلَى; born 8 January 1993) is a Jordanian footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Jordanian Pro League side Al-Hussein and the Jordan national team.
Yazeed Abulaila.note: Laila stands out for staying ready through long quiet spells. He keeps his decisions calm when a sudden save is required. In a separate phase, Laila leaves his line only with a clear route to take pressure off his defenders.
Yazeed Abulaila.noteZh: 长时间无事可做后依然保持专注是理解Yazeed Abu Laila踢法的关键。先看他如何在突然需要扑救时仍能冷静判断。到了另一个比赛环节，他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Douglas Santos.name: Douglas Santos
Douglas Santos.summary: Douglas dos Santos Justino de Melo (Russian: Дуглас До Сантос Жустино Де Мело; born 22 March 1994), known as Douglas Santos or simply Douglas (Brazilian Portuguese: [ˈdowɡlɐs ˈsɐ̃tus]), is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for...
Douglas Santos.note: What separates Santos is choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. Santos waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. Also note how he turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Douglas Santos.noteZh: Douglas Santos最鲜明的特点是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。一个直接线索是他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。另一个独立细节是他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Ederson Silva.name: Ederson Silva
Ederson Silva.summary: Éderson José dos Santos Lourenço da Silva (born 7 July 1999), simply known as Éderson (Brazilian Portuguese: [ˈɛdeʁsõ(w̃)]), is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Serie A club Atalanta and the Brazil national team.
Ederson Silva.note: The key to Silva is waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. A separate part of his game is how Silva angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Ederson Silva.noteZh: 理解Ederson Silva，要先看等防守者注意力转移后再启动。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。比赛进入另一种局面时，他也会在接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。
